We’re building more than events—we’re building a media and community brand at the center of the startup ecosystem.



As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a highly organized Marketing Project Lead who can help ensure our marketing initiatives stay aligned, on schedule, and moving forward.



About the Role

The Marketing Project Lead is a project management role focused on keeping Founders & Funders’ marketing and media initiatives organized and moving from idea to completion.



This is not a people-management position. Instead, you’ll be responsible for managing projects, timelines, priorities, dependencies, and deliverables across different contributors and functions.



You’ll work closely with the Media & Production team, LinkedIn/Content team, and other marketing contributors to make sure everyone understands what needs to be done, who owns each deliverable, and when it needs to be completed.

You’ll be the person making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Responsibilities:

1. Marketing Project Management

- Own and manage timelines for key marketing and media projects

- Create clear project plans, milestones, deadlines, and deliverables

- Coordinate projects across the Newsletter, Website, Podcast, Media & Production, and LinkedIn/Content functions

- Ensure everyone involved understands their responsibilities, deadlines, and dependencies

- Follow up on outstanding tasks and deliverables to keep projects moving

- Identify bottlenecks, delays, or dependencies before they become larger issues

- Maintain visibility into project status and communicate updates to leadership

- Help prioritize projects based on business needs, deadlines, and available resources

- Keep project documentation, timelines, and workflows organized

- Establish repeatable project management processes and workflows



2. Newsletter Projects

- Coordinate the planning and production timeline for the Founders & Funders newsletter

- Ensure content, design, approvals, and publishing stay on schedule

- Coordinate with writers, designers, editors, and other contributors

- Track newsletter deliverables from initial concept through publication

- Ensure deadlines are clearly communicated and followed



3. Website Projects

- Coordinate website updates, new pages, campaigns, and other website-related projects

- Work with designers, developers, content contributors, and other stakeholders

- Establish timelines and track website deliverables

- Ensure required content, assets, approvals, and technical updates are completed on time

- Communicate project status and flag delays or blockers



4. Podcast Projects

- Manage the project timeline for podcast episodes from planning through publication

- Coordinate guest scheduling, recording, editing, graphics, show notes, publishing, and promotion

- Ensure each contributor understands their deliverables and deadlines

- Track episode progress and follow up on outstanding items

- Coordinate with the Media & Production team to keep episodes moving toward publication

- Ensure podcast content is properly handed off for repurposing across other marketing channels



5. Other Marketing & Brand Projects

- Manage timelines and deliverables for other marketing and brand initiatives as assigned

- Coordinate campaigns, launches, events, partnerships, promotional initiatives, and special marketing projects

- Work with internal teams and external contributors to ensure projects move from concept to completion

- Translate marketing priorities into clear project plans, action items, owners, and deadlines

- Coordinate creative, content, design, media, and other deliverables required for each project

- Monitor progress and proactively follow up to keep projects on track

- Identify gaps, dependencies, and potential delays and escalate them when necessary

- Help ensure all marketing and brand projects are aligned with Founders & Funders’ goals, messaging, and brand standards



6. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Serve as the central point of coordination for assigned marketing projects

- Work with the Media & Production team, LinkedIn Specialist, content contributors, designers, editors, and other team members

- Keep projects aligned across multiple functions and moving toward the same objective

- Facilitate project check-ins and provide clear status updates when needed

- Make sure deliverables are completed according to agreed timelines and standards

- Escalate significant delays, resource constraints, or project risks to leadership

- Help leadership maintain visibility across active marketing initiatives



Qualifications:

- At least 4 years experience in project management, marketing project management, operations, or a similar coordination role

- Strong organizational and project management skills

- Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously

- Excellent follow-through and attention to detail

- Strong communication and coordination skills

- Comfortable working across multiple teams and contributors

- Able to create structure and clarity in a fast-moving environment

- Proactive—you identify what needs to happen next and make sure it happens

- Strong at following up without micromanaging

- Comfortable identifying and escalating blockers when necessary

- Resourceful and scrappy—you can find solutions when plans change or information is incomplete

- Adaptable and comfortable working in a startup environment

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability

- Comfortable using project management and collaboration tools such as 
, Asana, Trello, Notion, Slack, or similar platforms



Nice to Have

- Experience managing marketing, media, content, or creative projects

- Experience coordinating newsletters, websites, podcasts, or digital media

- Experience working with cross-functional marketing teams

- Familiarity with content production workflows

- Experience working in a startup, media, events, or fast-growing company

- Experience working with remote or distributed teams

- Familiarity with tools such as Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Google Workspace, and other marketing platforms



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means that marketing projects move forward smoothly, deadlines are visible and respected, and deliverables are completed without things falling through the cracks.



You’ll create the structure and accountability that allows our marketing and media contributors to do their best work.



You won’t be expected to manage the people doing the work—you’ll manage the projects, timelines, coordination, and execution that keep everyone moving in the same direction.

title: TikTok Shop & Social Commerce Marketing Specialist
description:
About World Famous Puppies & Zaza



World Famous Puppies is looking for a creative, technically skilled AI Livestream & Digital Marketing Specialist to help grow our puppy business and pet vitamin brand through TikTok, AI-powered livestreaming, paid advertising, and social media marketing.



You will work with both World Famous Puppies and Zaza’s social media pages.



We need someone who understands how to use AI livestreaming tools, create engaging live shopping experiences, and drive targeted traffic that can turn into real customers and product sales.



Our business sells puppies and dog vitamins. We want to reach people interested in puppies, pet wellness, and pet products while building awareness and sales through livestreams and digital advertising.



This is not just a social media posting job. We need someone who understands marketing, livestream technology, advertising, and sales conversion.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Livestreaming

Set up, operate, and manage AI-powered livestreams using suitable platforms and tools.

Create engaging livestream experiences featuring World Famous Puppies, Zaza, our puppies, and pet vitamins.

Use AI tools for livestream production, virtual presenters or avatars, scripts, captions, and other appropriate live content.

Help develop livestream formats that attract viewers, maintain engagement, and encourage viewers to explore our products.

Troubleshoot livestream setup, audio, video, overlays, and technical issues.

Research new AI livestreaming tools and recommend solutions that fit our business.

Ensure livestreams are transparent and comply with platform requirements regarding AI-generated or prerecorded content.

2. Traffic Generation & Digital Marketing

Develop strategies to drive viewers to our TikTok pages and livestreams.

Create promotional campaigns before, during, and after livestreams.

Use organic content, paid advertising, and creator partnerships to attract relevant audiences.

Develop strategies to attract people interested in puppies and dog vitamins.

Analyze traffic sources and identify which campaigns generate meaningful engagement and sales.

Coordinate with our team to promote upcoming livestreams and product features.

3. Paid TikTok Advertising

Create, launch, manage, and optimize paid TikTok advertising campaigns.

Develop video ad concepts and test different creative approaches and audiences.

Monitor advertising spend, clicks, conversions, customer acquisition costs, and return on ad spend.

Identify ways to improve campaign performance and reduce wasted advertising spend.

Create reports showing campaign performance and recommendations for improvement.

4. TikTok Shop & Product Sales

Add and manage eligible products through TikTok Shop or other available commerce features.

Create and optimize product listings for our dog vitamins and other eligible merchandise.

Help organize products so viewers can discover and purchase them during livestreams.

Develop strategies to increase product clicks and completed purchases.

Verify product information, pricing, and inventory before promoting products.

Research affiliate and creator opportunities that can help generate sales.

5. World Famous Puppies Marketing

Help generate qualified inquiries from customers interested in purchasing puppies.

Develop content and advertising concepts featuring available puppies.

Help direct interested customers to the appropriate World Famous Puppies sales team.

Coordinate with our sales team to ensure customers receive accurate information about puppy availability, pricing, and delivery.

Keep puppy sales promotions separate from vitamin product listings and follow the relevant platform rules for each category.

6. Zaza Social Media Growth

Help develop marketing strategies for Zaza’s TikTok page.

Use Zaza’s content and personality to build audience engagement and promote appropriate brand products.

Develop livestream concepts and promotional campaigns around Zaza.

Identify opportunities to collaborate with pet creators and relevant brands.

Track audience growth, engagement, traffic, and sales-related results.

7. Analytics & Reporting

Track livestream viewers, watch time, engagement, clicks, and conversions.

Monitor advertising performance and product sales.

Provide regular reports showing what is working and what needs improvement.

Recommend new strategies based on actual performance data.

Required Skills & Experience



Applicants should have:



Practical experience with AI livestreaming tools and technology.

Experience using AI tools for video production, livestream content, or digital marketing.

Experience driving traffic through TikTok or other social media platforms.

Hands-on experience with paid advertising, preferably TikTok Ads.

Understanding of e-commerce marketing and product conversion.

Strong creative skills and the ability to develop engaging livestream concepts.

Experience analyzing campaign results and making data-driven improvements.

Good written English and the ability to communicate with a U.S.-based team.

Reliable internet access and the ability to work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with TikTok Shop or livestream shopping.

Experience marketing pet products, vitamins, supplements, or other consumer products.

Experience with AI avatars, virtual presenters, automated livestream production, or AI video tools.

Experience with affiliate marketing and influencer partnerships.

Experience promoting products through TikTok LIVE.

Application Questions



Please answer these questions when applying:



Which AI livestreaming tools have you personally used?

Have you created or managed AI-powered livestreams? Please provide examples.

Have you run paid TikTok advertising campaigns? What were the results?

Have you driven traffic to livestreams and helped generate product sales?

Have you worked with TikTok Shop or livestream shopping?

Have you marketed pet products, vitamins, or supplements?

Please provide links to your portfolio, livestream examples, or campaign case studies.

What is your expected monthly salary?

Can you work full-time and coordinate with a U.S.-based team?



Applications without relevant AI livestreaming, paid advertising, or digital marketing experience may not be suitable for this position.



Practical Hiring Test



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to prepare a brief marketing plan covering:



How they would set up an AI livestream for Zaza.

How they would drive traffic to that livestream.

How they would promote World Famous Puppies and dog vitamins through appropriate content and campaigns.

How they would use paid advertising to attract relevant audiences.

Which metrics they would track to measure success.



Our ideal candidate is someone who can combine AI livestream technology with real marketing skills to attract viewers, generate qualified puppy inquiries, and sell eligible pet products.

title: AI VIDEO EDITOR | META ADS + DTC E-COMMERCE | FULL-TIME
description:
AI VIDEO EDITOR | META ADS + DTC E-COMMERCE | FULL-TIME

Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term | $1,300 USD/month

We're looking for a video editor who is excited about the future of performance advertising.

AI is changing how e-commerce brands produce creative, and we're building a workflow where traditional editing, direct-response thinking and AI-generated visuals work together.

We operate multiple DTC e-commerce brands in the health, wellness and supplement space, primarily targeting European markets.

We're looking for a full-time video editor who can combine:

Direct Response + Video Editing + AI

to create high-performing ads for
, Instagram and other paid channels.

This is NOT just an AI generation role.

And it's NOT a traditional video editing role where the goal is simply to make videos look polished.

We're looking for someone who understands that every scene, hook, cut and visual choice should help improve attention, retention and conversion.

WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING

You'll work on creatives such as:

- Meta /
 video ads

- Instagram ads

- UGC-style ads

- Direct-response ads

- VSL-style videos

- Advertorial videos

- AI-generated scenes

- AI avatars

- Product ads

- Customer testimonial ads

- Short-form performance creatives

- Longer 2–5+ minute ads

- Multiple hook variations

- Variations of winning creatives

- 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 formats

Some ads will use real footage.

Some will use UGC.

Some will use AI-generated images and video.

Many will combine all three.

AI WILL BE PART OF YOUR DAILY WORK

Our workflow includes tools such as:

- Higgsfield

- HeyGen

- ElevenLabs

- CapCut Desktop

- AI image generation tools

- AI video generation tools

- Google Drive

Experience with tools such as:

- Kling

- Runway

- Veo

- Nano Banana

- Midjourney

- ChatGPT

- Premiere Pro

- After Effects

is a plus.

You don't need to already know every tool.

However, you should be comfortable experimenting, learning quickly and using AI to solve creative problems.

For example:

If the script requires a specific scene and the footage doesn't exist, we don't want you to stop.

We want you to think:

"Can I generate this?"

"Can I create a better visual?"

"Can I use AI to make this scene more engaging?"

DIRECT RESPONSE MATTERS

Being good with AI is not enough.

You must also understand how performance ads work.

You should understand concepts such as:

- Hooks

- Scroll stopping

- Pattern interrupts

- Pacing

- Retention

- Curiosity

- Problem agitation

- Product mechanisms

- Benefits

- Testimonials

- Social proof

- Offers

- CTAs

- Creative testing

You should be able to analyze a winning ad and understand WHY it works.

Then you should be able to create new variations without simply copying it.

For example:

Hook -> Problem -> Agitation -> Mechanism -> Solution -> Proof -> Offer -> CTA

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will receive:

- Scripts

- Voiceovers

- Product assets

- Brand assets

- UGC footage

- Competitor references

- Creative briefs

- Examples of winning creatives

You will be responsible for:

- Editing complete ads

- Finding relevant B-roll

- Generating AI images and video scenes

- Creating AI avatar scenes when necessary

- Matching visuals closely to voiceovers

- Creating engaging subtitles

- Adding sound effects and music

- Creating visual pattern interrupts

- Creating multiple opening hooks

- Iterating on winning ads

- Testing different visual approaches

- Creating different aspect ratios

- Organizing project files

- Delivering editable project files when required

Over time, we want you to become increasingly independent.

We don't want to tell you exactly what visual to use every 3 seconds.

We want you to understand the creative objective and help us find the best execution.

LANGUAGE

Most of our ads are in Italian.

You do NOT need to speak Italian.

We will provide Italian scripts, voiceovers and English translations whenever necessary.

Your job is to understand the meaning and choose or generate the appropriate visuals.

Italian subtitles and on-screen text will be provided.

You must copy them accurately and never independently rewrite or translate Italian copy.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You'll probably be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing e-commerce ads

- Understand Meta/Facebook advertising

- Understand direct-response creative

- Have experience with AI image/video tools

- Are comfortable experimenting with new tools

- Have strong instincts for hooks and pacing

- Can create multiple variations quickly

- Can follow competitor references without blindly copying them

- Can work independently

- Are organized and reliable

- Meet deadlines

- Respond well to feedback

- Care about performance

We especially like editors who naturally ask:

"How can I make this ad more engaging?"

"What can I test here?"

"Can I make the hook stronger?"

rather than simply finishing the assigned edit.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

Please do not apply if:

- You only want to edit cinematic content

- Your experience is mainly weddings, gaming or podcasts

- You dislike using AI tools

- You need detailed instructions for every scene

- You don't understand paid social advertising

- You are not interested in performance creative

This is a direct-response e-commerce advertising role.

SCHEDULE

Full-time — 40 hours per week.

Fully remote.

Long-term position.

Some overlap with European working hours is preferred.

Reliability, communication and consistent delivery are extremely important.

COMPENSATION

$1,300 USD/month — fixed salary

Full-time, 40 hours per week.

There will be a salary review after the first 90 days based on:

- Quality of work

- Reliability

- Speed

- Independence

- Growth in responsibilities

- Overall contribution to the creative team

PAID TEST

Selected candidates will complete a paid editing test.

We will provide:

- Script

- Voiceover

- Product assets

- Creative brief

- Competitor references

We care much more about:

- Hook quality

- Visual choices

- Pacing

- Storytelling

- Direct-response thinking

- Ability to use AI intelligently

than fancy transitions.

HOW TO APPLY

All applications must be submitted through this form:



The application takes approximately 10 minutes.

You will be required to submit a 2–3 minute video introduction.

Applications without the video introduction will not be reviewed.

IMPORTANT

When the application asks:

"Why do you want this position?"

Start your answer with the word:

ORANGE

This lets us know you read the entire job description.

Applications sent directly through OnlineJobs messages without completing the form will not be reviewed.

We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our creative team and help us build the next generation of performance advertising.

title: Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist (Flows and Campaigns) for UK Ecommerce Agency

KLAVIYO
 MARKETING SPECIALIST

Sabre Digital | Remote, Philippines | Full Time, long term

1 position. Immediate start.



ABOUT US

Sabre Digital is a London based ecommerce growth agency. We build and scale Shopify stores for UK, US and AU DTC brands across fashion, jewellery, homeware and personalised products. Our work covers email retention, paid advertising, Shopify development and conversion rate optimisation.



We are hiring a Klaviyo specialist to own retention across our client accounts, working alongside our paid media and development teams.



THE ROLE

You own Klaviyo end to end for multiple client brands: strategy, build, copy, design, segmentation, sending and reporting. Retention should be delivering 25 to 35% of each client's revenue and your job is to get it there and keep it there.



This is a full ownership role. You are not handed a calendar to execute. You build the calendar, you d
 what gets tested, and you report on what it made.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

FLOWS

- Build, audit and optimise the full flow set: welcome, abandoned cart, abandoned checkout, browse abandonment, post purchase, thank you and review request, winback, sunset, back in stock, price drop, VIP and replenishment

- Design multi step flows with proper conditional splits, timing and exclusion logic rather than single email sequences

- Continuously A/B test subject lines, send timing, offer strength and flow structure

- Set up and maintain SMS flows where clients use them



CAMPAIGNS

- Plan and run the monthly campaign calendar across all client accounts, including seasonal and Q4 peak planning

- Write and build campaigns end to end: strategy, copy, design, segmentation, scheduling

- Segment properly by engagement, purchase history, product affinity and lifecycle stage. No batch and blast to the full list

- Coordinate campaign timing with the paid team so promotions and offers match across channels



TECHNICAL AND DELIVERABILITY

- Manage list health, engagement segments, sunset policies and suppression

- Monitor and protect deliverability: sender reputation, spam complaints, domain authentication, warming new accounts

- Set up and maintain Shopify integration, custom events, profile properties and catalogue feeds

- Build and maintain popups, signup forms and lead capture, and test them for capture rate

- Ensure revenue attribution is set up correctly and reported honestly



REPORTING

You make the ads. Statics, video, UGC edits, motion. Volume matters here: paid social burns through creative and the accounts that win are the ones testing the most concepts. You will be briefed on concept, hook and angle by the media buyer, and your job is to turn that into finished, platform ready assets fast, without the quality dropping.

STATIC CREATIVE

- Generate AI product imagery and lifestyle scenes from supplied product shots, keeping product accuracy exact

- Retouch, cut out, composite and colour match to a high standard

- Build variations at pace. One concept usually needs five to ten versions to test properly

- Adapt every asset to the required ratios: 1x1, 4x5, 9x16 and story safe zones



VIDEO CREATIVE

- Edit video ads for Meta and TikTok from supplied UGC, brand footage, product clips and stock

- Cut strong hooks. The first two seconds d
 the result and you will be judged on them

- Add captions, on screen text, sound design, music and transitions in native platform style

- Produce AI generated video segments, AI voiceover and AI avatar content where appropriate

- Turn one piece of footage into multiple distinct ads with different hooks and edits

- Produce static to video conversions and motion graphic ads from still assets



PROCESS

- Work from written creative briefs and reference examples, matching the brief rather than reinterpreting it

- Maintain each client's brand consistency: fonts, colours, tone, product accuracy

- Manage file naming, versioning and delivery so the buyer can launch without chasing you

- Track assets through ClickUp and communicate proactively on Slack or WhatsApp

- Feed observations back. If you notice a format performing across accounts, say so



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR (ESSENTIAL)

- A portfolio of paid social ad creative, not general graphic design. We want to see ads that ran

- Strong Photoshop and video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve)

- Genuine working experience with AI creative tools: image generation, generative fill, AI video, AI voiceover

- Speed with quality. This role is measured on both

- Understanding of what makes a scroll stopping ad, and the ability to explain why one works

- Strong written English to interpret briefs and respond to feedback

- Reliable high speed internet and a computer capable of running professional editing software

- Available full time with hours overlapping UK business hours



DESIRABLE

- Experience producing creative specifically for Meta and TikTok at volume

- Figma proficiency

- Motion graphics and After Effects work

- Experience with UGC editing and creator sourced footage

- An understanding of ad account metrics such as hook rate, hold rate and CTR

- Copywriting instinct for on screen text and hooks



HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

- Volume of assets delivered against the testing roadmap

- Hook rate, hold rate and CTR of the creative you produce

- Number of revision rounds needed before an asset is launch ready

- Turnaround time from brief to delivery

- Brand and product accuracy. Wrong product colours are a serious error



WHAT IS ON OFFER

- Full time, stable, long term remote work with a growing agency

- A dedicated media buyer feeding you clear briefs and telling you exactly how your work performed, which is how you get better fast

- Freedom to use AI tooling properly rather than being told to do everything the slow way

- Direct access to the founder, fast decisions, no corporate layers

title: Head of Sales & Business Development – IT Services & AI Solutions
description:
Who We Are

Six Consulting is a U.S.-based technology and consulting company helping mid-market businesses improve how work gets done through automation, connected systems, and AI. Founded in 2007, we combine business understanding, process expertise, and technology to solve complex operational challenges and deliver measurable results.

We are a lean, entrepreneurial company entering our next phase of growth around AI-enabled workflows, automation, systems integration, and technology transformation.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a senior, hands-on sales leader based in the Philippines who can own and build our revenue engine.

Think CRO-level thinking with founder-level execution.

Initially, there will be no sales team underneath you. You will personally research markets, identify prospects, build lists, write outreach, run campaigns, conduct discovery calls, shape solutions, prepare proposals, negotiate, and close deals.

As the model begins to work, you will help determine what parts of the sales process should be systematized, automated, or eventually delegated to additional sales resources.

This role is ideal for someone who has the strategic ability to build a go-to-market motion but is still comfortable doing the work personally.

What You’ll Own

Go-to-Market Strategy: Identify the industries, buyer profiles, use cases, and offers where Six has the strongest opportunity to win.

Hands-On Prospecting: Personally build target account lists, identify decisionmakers, and run outbound campaigns through LinkedIn,
, phone, referrals, and other channels.

Messaging & Outreach: Write and continuously improve outreach messaging, sequences, positioning, and sales collateral based on market feedback.

Executive Selling: Engage CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, COOs, PE operating teams, and other senior decision-makers.

Discovery: Lead conversations to uncover workflow bottlenecks, inefficient systems, post-merger integration issues, AI opportunities, and other operational problems.

Solution Development: Work directly with our technical team to translate business problems into credible technology solutions.

Deal Ownership: Own opportunities from first contact through proposal, SOW, negotiation, procurement, and close.

Pipeline Management: Maintain disciplined CRM usage, forecasting, follow-ups, and pipeline visibility.

Experimentation: Test new industries, offers, messaging, channels, and sales approaches quickly and determine where we should double down.

Build the Function: Once a repeatable sales motion emerges, help design and eventually build the broader sales organization.

What We’re Looking For

7+ years of B2B sales or business development experience, ideally selling IT services, consulting, custom software, cloud, AI, automation, or digital transformation.

A track record of personally sourcing and closing business, not just managing salespeople or inbound opportunities.

Experience selling into the U.S. market and communicating confidently with senior executives.

Strong commercial instincts and the ability to quickly understand how a company operates, where inefficiencies exist, and where technology can create measurable value.

Comfortable doing your own prospect research, outreach, follow-up, discovery, proposals, and deal management.

Enough technical fluency to discuss AI, workflow automation, integrations, cloud, data, and enterprise systems credibly.

Comfortable working in an environment where the go-to-market playbook is still being developed.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Highly resourceful, self-directed, analytical, and accountable for outcomes.

Willing and able to work consistently during U.S. business hours.

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

You may have held titles such as Head of Sales, Sales Director, Business Development Director, or CRO — but you have never become too senior to sell.

You are comfortable spending Monday thinking about market positioning and Tuesday personally sending outreach messages and calling prospects.

You enjoy figuring out what to sell, who to sell it to, how to reach them, and how to close them.

You don't need a large team, a big marketing budget, or a mature sales infrastructure to get started.

You build first. Then you scale what works.

What We Offer

100% remote environment

Competitive base compensation

Uncapped commission with meaningful upside tied directly to revenue generated

Direct access to the founder and technical leadership

Significant autonomy over go-to-market strategy

Opportunity to build the sales function from the ground up

Paid Philippine holidays and regular PTO

Potential to evolve into a broader Chief Revenue Officer role as the company scales

How to Apply

Please send:

Your updated resume.

A short description of one meaningful IT, consulting, software, or technology services deal that you personally sourced and closed, including approximate deal size.

An example of a time you built pipeline from scratch rather than inheriting an existing pipeline.

Your target monthly base compensation and expected total earnings with commission.

In 3–5 sentences: If you joined Six Consulting with no SDR team and no existing outbound engine, what would you personally do in your first 30 days to create qualified pipeline?

Follow up directly with team members on outstanding tasks — politely, but consistently — and report back on what's done and what's still open

Excellent written English — this is essential, not preferred

Strong experience with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Drive)

Comfortable learning new software quickly (we use JobTread and Loop)

Strong organizational and follow-up systems of your own

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (Soft Skills)



You follow through on things without being reminded

You communicate clearly and proactively — you don't disappear when something is unclear, you ask

HOURS & PAY

title: Press & Outreach Manager for a Nationally-Touring Comedy Show
description:
ABOUT THE SHOW



I produce and host a nationally-touring comedy/dating show called Love Isn't Blind - the gimmick is that the men can't speak. Four men compete for one bachelorette. We have real success stories, including two marriages.



We've been featured on NBC's California Live, The Tamron Hall Show, and more. I currently tour Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, Portland, Seattle, New York, and Washington DC.



THE ROLE



I need someone to take over press, marketing, and outreach entirely. Right now I do all of it myself, on top of producing and hosting the actual show, and I simply don't have the time anymore. I'm drowning!



To be clear: this is NOT a social media manager role. I'm not looking for content calendars or follower growth. *This is a pitching job.*



Here's what you'd own:



PRESS - Local city press, alt-weeklies, newsletters, event calendars, culture reporters, national trend reporters. Finding the right person at each outlet, verifying their actual beat, and writing a pitch that fits what they publish. I do NOT want my pitches to feel or sound like spam.



PODCASTS - Dating, comedy, culture, and sometimes entrepreneurial. Vetting a show's recent episodes before claiming a fit, then pitching me and the show as a guest.



COMMUNITY & GROUP OUTREACH - Rec sports leagues, run clubs, alumni clubs, young professionals groups. A discount code in exchange for sharing the show with their members.



CREATOR OUTREACH - Pitching relevant influencers to cover the show.



EVENT CALENDARS - Submissions for every show, in every city.



WHAT MATTERS MOST:



RESEARCH THAT HOLDS UP. This is the big one. Verify on an org's own live site or social profile before pitching them. If you can't confirm something, please just say so! I would much rather hear "I couldn't confirm this" than get a confident pitch built on a dead link.



WRITING. Short, punchy, sometimes funny pitches, all day long. Your written English needs to pass as native in an
 to an American reporter. This one is a hard requirement.



FLUENCY WITH CLAUDE. I run my entire outreach operation through it, and I want someone who can do it better than I can - and who double-checks every factual claim it produces. If your instinct is to paste AI output straight into an
, this isn't the job. 



JUDGMENT. Knowing who NOT to pitch is half the job.



ORGANIZATION. You'll be pitching seven cities at once, and hopefully more in 2027.



REQUIREMENTS:



- 2+ years in pitching, PR, publicity, marketing, or partnerships, where you had to persuade a stranger over

- At home in Gmail, Google Sheets, Drive, and Instagram DMs

- I do NOT want someone to have to work all night for this job. That said, it would be great to hire an early bird who is okay to start between 7-8 am local time, because that means we can at least overlap working hours from about 4-7 pm my time daily. Press does require fast responses when we receive interest. I will also want to be cc'ed on every
 so that if something time sensitive comes in while you're asleep, I can get to it!



STRONGLY PREFERRED:



- Experience pitching entertainment: live events, comedy, theater, film, festivals, touring acts, talent - in the U.S., Europe, or Canada.

- Canva-level graphic design for cover photos and event graphics

- Familiarity with Eventbrite

- You like comedy and have opinions about it



WHERE THIS GOES:



I'd love this to grow into owning the strategy: which cities are underperforming, which channels actually convert, moving from discount codes to affiliate links and real data, and building templates and AI workflows.



COMP:



Please let me know your rate. This is a full time position, but I would like to do a paid trial first.



TO APPLY


 a resume and a short cover letter to 
 love to know:



- What hours you could work in PST?

- The most relevant pitching you've done and an example pitch.

- How you use AI in your work, and one example of something you got it to do well.



Thank you!

 marketing for Shopify businesses.

title: Email & Growth Marketing Manager (Klaviyo) — Wholesale Brand, EU Hours
description:
Botanopia is a small design-led brand from Amsterdam. We make plant products: cyanotype kits, embroidered brooches, rainbow-projecting stickers, plant care tools. We sell to around 1,200 independent shops across Europe and the US, and direct to customers through our own store.



We are looking for one person to own our
 and growth marketing completely.



Right now nobody owns it. Klaviyo is set up and underused, our wholesale customers hear from us far less than they should, and our best retailers reorder out of habit rather than because we asked. That is the problem you would be solving.



WHAT YOU WOULD OWN



- Klaviyo end to end: flows, segmentation, campaigns, deliverability, reporting

- Our wholesale audience: roughly 1,200 shops, plus a direct-to-consumer list

- Reactivating retailers who have stopped ordering, and growing the ones who still do

- Our listings and campaigns on Faire, the wholesale marketplace we sell through

-
 copy in English, written to our brand voice

- Over time, building and leading a small marketing team



This is not a role where you execute someone else's brief. You d
 what gets built.



WHAT WE NEED



- 2+ years hands-on Klaviyo. Not "familiar with." You have built flows from scratch, segmented lists yourself, and know why a send went to spam.

- Experience marketing a physical product. Retail, e-commerce, or a consumer brand. Not services, not gaming, not crypto.

- Strong written English. You will be writing to shop owners in France, Germany and the Netherlands under our name.

- An eye for design. We are a design brand. If an
 looks loud or cluttered, it is wrong for us.

- Self-directed. Small team, no one looking over your shoulder, which also means no one to tell you what to do next.



NICE TO HAVE



- B2B or wholesale experience. Selling to shops is different from selling to shoppers.

- Faire, Shopify or WooCommerce

- Comfortable using AI tools in your work. We do, daily.



THE PRACTICAL PART



- Full time, 40 hours a week, long term. This would be your only job.

- Schedule: 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM Philippine time, Monday to Friday. Some flexibility, but you need real overlap with Amsterdam.

- $2,300 to $2,500 USD per month depending on experience, paid monthly via Wise.

- Reviewed at 6 months.

- We use ManicTime for time tracking. Two reasons, and I would rather be upfront: so we can look together at where your time actually produces revenue and what to stop or automate, and because I have been burned by "full-time" hires who were billing the same hours to other clients. You are judged on results, not on tracked activity.



HOW TO APPLY



Please put the word BROOCH at the start of your application so I know you read this.



Then answer these five questions. Short answers are fine. I care about specifics, not polish. Applications that skip them will not be reviewed.



1. What is the biggest difference between marketing to wholesale shops and marketing to end consumers?



2. Describe one Klaviyo flow you built from scratch. What triggered it, what was in the sequence, and what did it do to revenue or repeat purchases?



3. Have you managed anyone, or a group of freelancers? How did you structure it, and what went wrong?



4. Are you working any other jobs or client work right now?



5. What are your normal working hours, and can you commit to the schedule above?

WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your primary responsibility will be to identify builders and developers in our target markets, contact them, speak with the person responsible for land acquisition, and determine exactly what type of vacant land they are currently looking to purchase.



You will:



* Research active builders and land developers in specific markets

* Identify the decision maker responsible for land acquisition

* Call builders and developers directly

* Speak professionally with acquisition managers, owners, land managers, and developers

* Qualify builders based on their current land-buying activity

* Find out exactly what types of land they are looking for

* Obtain their specific land acquisition criteria and buy box

* Determine their preferred locations and counties

* Determine acreage requirements

* Determine desired number of lots

* Determine zoning requirements

* Determine utility requirements

* Determine price ranges and land budgets

* Determine whether they purchase raw land, entitled land, finished lots, or development sites

* Determine their preferred property characteristics

* Determine what makes them immediately reject a property

* Determine how frequently they are currently acquiring land

* Determine their acquisition timeline

* Identify their preferred method of receiving opportunities

* Maintain accurate records of every conversation

* Enter qualified buyers and their criteria into our CRM

* Follow up with qualified builders to keep their buying criteria current

* Build long-term relationships with active land buyers



The goal is NOT simply to build a list of builders.



The goal is to build a database of QUALIFIED, ACTIVE builders with specific and actionable buying criteria.



For example, we don’t want:



“ABC Homes buys land in Texas.”



We want:



“ABC Homes is actively looking for 5-15 acre residential development sites in X County, needs public water and sewer, prefers 20+ potential lots, budget is up to $1.5M, and is looking to acquire another site within the next 90 days.”



That is the level of information we are looking for.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have previous experience with one or more of the following:



* Calling home builders

* Calling land developers

* Builder acquisition

* Land acquisition

* Real estate acquisitions

* Real estate wholesaling

* Land wholesaling

* Land development

* Builder/developer prospecting

* Qualifying real estate buyers

* Speaking with acquisition managers or decision makers



You must be comfortable getting on the phone and having professional conversations with builders and developers.



I am NOT looking for someone with no experience who needs to be taught how to do this from scratch.



If you have never spoken with builders or developers before, this position is probably not a good fit.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate:



* Has proven real estate experience

* Has experience speaking with builders or developers

* Is comfortable making outbound calls

* Can speak confidently with business owners and acquisition managers

* Knows how to ask good qualifying questions

* Can dig deeper instead of accepting vague answers

* Understands the difference between a general buyer lead and a qualified buyer

* Is highly organized

* Has excellent English communication skills

* Can accurately document conversations

* Understands real estate terminology

* Can work independently

* Is comfortable using a CRM

* Is results-oriented



IMPORTANT



This position requires someone who can have an intelligent conversation with a builder and uncover their actual acquisition needs.



You should be able to ask follow-up questions such as:



“What are you actively looking to acquire right now?”



“What counties are you currently buying in?”



“What acreage are you looking for?”



“How many lots would you ideally like to get from a site?”



“What zoning do you require?”



“Are you buying raw land or only entitled/finished lots?”



“What utilities do you require?”



“What is your typical land budget?”



“What are the biggest reasons you would reject a property?”



“When are you looking to acquire your next property?”



“How many properties are you currently looking for?”



“Who is the decision maker for purchasing land?”



This is about understanding the builder’s BUSINESS and BUYING CRITERIA, not simply collecting contact information.



TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years of real estate experience do you have?

2. What experience do you have working with home builders or land developers?

3. Have you personally called builders or developers to discuss their land acquisition needs? Explain exactly what you did.

4. What type of builders or developers have you spoken with?

5. What questions would you ask a builder to determine their land-buying criteria?

6. Give me an example of a builder buy box you have previously qualified.

7. Have you worked in vacant land, residential real estate, or both?

8. What CRM systems have you used?

9. How many outbound calls were you typically making per day in your previous position?

10. Please explain why you are no longer working with your previous client/employer.

11. How long have you been working in real estate?

12. How long have you been doing builder/developer outreach?



Please include the word BUILDER at the beginning of your application so I know you read the entire posting.

You speak clearly and confidently.

You want a long-term role that can grow into something bigger.

You are reliable, consistent, and professional.

You can work US hours.

You’re hungry enough to follow instructions and improve quickly.

You earn the $5 bonus only when

• you set the appointment

If you consistently hit metrics, you’ll have opportunities to move into

full-time appointment setting,

higher bonus tiers,

additional responsibilities in sales or operations, and

junior closer training

Tell us why you want the role, your availability, and give an example of how you’ve handled a difficult conversation.

If following simple instructions is difficult for you, this isn’t the right fit.

 prospecting

Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator

Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator to support our U.S.-based estimating team. This role is responsible for reviewing construction documents, performing detailed quantity takeoffs, identifying scope requirements, and preparing accurate rough carpentry estimates for commercial, multifamily, educational, prevailing wage, and other construction projects.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of wood framing construction and can independently interpret architectural and structural plans, specifications, details, sections, schedules, and general notes. Accuracy, attention to detail, organization, and clear communication are essential, particularly when identifying missing, conflicting, or unclear information.



Key Responsibilities:

Plan & Specification Review

* Review architectural, structural, and applicable civil plans.

* Review project specifications and identify requirements affecting the rough carpentry scope.

* Interpret plans, details, sections, schedules, and general notes.

* Identify discrepancies between architectural and structural drawings.

* Identify missing information and items requiring clarification or RFI.

* Review addenda, bulletins, RFIs, and revised drawings and determine their impact on the estimate.



Quantity Takeoffs

* Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs for rough carpentry materials and labor, including:

* Dimensional lumber, wall framing, wood stud walls, and interior/exterior framing

* Floor and roof framing, roof/floor/wall sheathing, plywood, and OSB

* Blocking and backing, miscellaneous wood framing, pressure-treated lumber, sill plates, and ledgers

* Posts and beams, glulam beams, LVL, and engineered wood products

* Hardware and connectors, including hold-downs, straps, clips, hangers, anchor bolts, and fastening requirements

* Trusses, roof/floor truss-related scope, and miscellaneous rough carpentry materials

* Clearly identify quantities by building, floor, area, and material type whenever applicable.



Labor Estimating

* Assist with developing labor quantities based on takeoff information.

* Understand the relationship between material quantities and field installation.

* Identify conditions that may increase labor requirements.

* Consider difficult access, height, phasing, sequencing, and other project conditions that may affect productivity.

* Identify prevailing wage or other labor requirements shown in the bid documents.



Scope Review

* Develop a thorough understanding of the complete rough carpentry scope and identify items that may be missed during a standard material takeoff.

* Review scope responsibilities and general contractor requirements.

* Account for temporary construction, equipment, hoisting, material handling, cleanup, protection, and layout.

* Identify blocking and backing, fire-treated, and pressure-treated lumber requirements.

* Review special inspection, engineering, and deferred submittal requirements.

* Coordinate rough carpentry scope with structural steel, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other trades.



Estimate Preparation

* Organize takeoffs in accordance with company estimating standards.

* Enter quantities accurately into company estimating software and templates.

* Maintain clear supporting documentation for all quantities.

* Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, and clarifications.

* Identify potential cost risks before the estimate is finalized.

* Compare estimates against historical information when available.

* Assist the lead estimator in preparing the final proposal.



Quality Control

* Perform a complete self-review of the takeoff and verify quantities against plans.

* Confirm all buildings and areas have been included.

* Review architectural quantities against structural requirements.

* Confirm plan revisions and addenda have been incorporated.

* Verify that major material quantities are reasonable.

* Check for duplicated or missing scope.

* Clearly identify questionable conditions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

* Maintain organized takeoff files so they can be easily reviewed by another estimator.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous experience estimating rough carpentry, wood framing, or wood-frame construction

* Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and structural construction documents

* Experience performing detailed construction quantity takeoffs

* Strong understanding of wood framing systems and construction sequencing

* Familiarity with lumber, plywood, OSB, engineered wood products, trusses, hardware, and connectors

* Strong mathematical, analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and meet assigned deadlines

* Strong ability to identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and unusual project conditions

* Ability to clearly communicate questions, assumptions, and potential problems

* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a U.S.-based estimating team

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Bluebeam Revu experience preferred

* Experience with On-Screen Takeoff or similar takeoff software preferred

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams

* Experience with construction estimating software and PDF plan/specification management systems is a plus

* Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification rather than make unsupported assumptions

* Able to work during agreed-upon overlapping hours with the U.S.-based team



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: CREATIVE STRATEGIST: HEALTH, BEAUTY META ADS AND DIRECT RESPONSE
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a growing health, beauty, and wellness ecommerce company running Meta ads across several international stores.



We are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist who can find strong swipes, develop original angles, write persuasive direct-response copy, and guide Image Ad Creators in producing effective static ads.



This is not a general social media, media-buying, or graphic-design role. You must understand ecommerce advertising, customer psychology, creative research, advertorial funnels, and how to turn market insights into concepts that can be tested and scaled.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Break down the hook, angle, offer, structure, customer desire, and visual approach behind each reference.

- Turn research into original concepts, direct-response copy, offers, and detailed creative briefs.

- Guide Image Ad Creators and ensure their work follows the intended strategy and brief.

- Develop genuinely new concepts instead of repeatedly redesigning an existing angle.

- Create thoughtful iterations of proven winners while preserving the reason the original creative worked.

- Review campaign performance with the media-buying team and use the results to plan the next tests.

- Maintain an organized testing pipeline across assigned products, stores, and markets.

- Follow Meta compliance requirements for health, beauty, and wellness advertising.

- Report creative winners, failures, learnings, bottlenecks, and next actions clearly.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven Creative Strategist experience with ecommerce or dropshipping brands.

- Strong swipe-research, direct-response, and customer-research skills.

- Able to explain why an ad may be performing and turn that insight into an original concept.

 what to iterate, stop, replace, or scale.

NICE TO HAVE

title: AI Agent Developer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a developer who lives at the intersection of AI and automation. You'll design and build fully autonomous creative pipelines that take a single prompt and produce complete, polished advertisements — visuals, video, copy, and editing — with no manual intervention and other sorts of Ai agents that helps our beauty brand Faccelove function more efficiently. 



You'll work with Claude Code as the orchestration backbone, integrating third-party generative AI services (NanoBanana for image generation, Higgsfield for AI video, and others) into seamless, production-grade workflows. The end goal: a system where a human provides a brief and gets back a finished creative asset.



What You'll Build

- Autonomous AI agent pipelines using Claude Code that chain together multiple generative AI services end-to-end

- API integrations with image generation (NanoBanana), video generation (Higgsfield), and editing/post-production tools

- Prompt engineering systems that translate high-level creative briefs into structured, multi-step agent workflows

- Quality control and feedback loops — automated checks that evaluate outputs and retry/refine when needed

- Robust error handling, state management, and logging for complex multi-API orchestration





Requirements (Must-Have)

- Hands-on experience building AI agents or agentic workflows (Claude Code, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar frameworks)

- Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript — you write clean, production-grade code, not just scripts

- Experience with LLM APIs: function calling / tool use, structured outputs, prompt chaining, and multi-turn orchestration

- Proven ability to integrate and orchestrate multiple third-party APIs in a single automated pipeline

- Solid understanding of async programming, error handling, retry logic, and building resilient systems



Nice-to-Have

- Familiarity with generative media APIs — image generation, video generation, or AI-driven editing tools

- Experience with creative production workflows (advertising, content creation, or media post-production)

- Background in MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool servers, or building custom tool integrations for LLMs



Tech Stack

- Claude Code, Anthropic API, Python, TypeScript, NanoBanana, Higgsfield, MCP, REST APIs, Webhooks, Git



What Sets You Apart

You don't just use AI tools — you build systems that make AI tools work together autonomously. You've shipped at least one project where an AI agent completes a multi-step task end-to-end without human intervention. You understand that the hardest part isn't the individual API calls — it's the orchestration, the edge cases, and making the whole pipeline reliable at scale.



You're comfortable in ambiguity. This space is new and moving fast. You'll often be the first person to figure out how to make two services talk to each other in a way nobody has documented yet.

What you’ll do

* Review profiles and applications against the requirements of each role, looking beyond job titles to understand what candidates have actually done.

* Write personalized outreach and follow up with candidates.

* Conduct initial screening calls and share clear, useful notes with hiring managers.

* Coordinate interviews, track candidate progress, and keep the hiring pipeline up to date.

* Help improve job posts, outreach messages, and sourcing methods based on what gets results.

* Give candidates a professional, responsive experience throughout the process.



You’ll support hiring across creative, marketing, ecommerce, and operations, with particular attention to finding people who want to contribute to an in-house team over the long term.



#What we’re looking for



* Some experience in recruiting, sourcing, HR, or a role involving research and outreach. Strong entry-level applicants are welcome.

* Confidence using LinkedIn to research people and assess relevant experience.

* Good written and spoken English.

* Strong organization and attention to detail.

* Curiosity about people, their work, and what motivates them.

* The ability to take feedback, improve quickly, and follow through without constant reminders.

* Good judgment: you can spot promising candidates while staying open-minded about different career paths.



Experience recruiting for ecommerce, creative, or performance marketing roles is a plus.



What success looks like



You build a consistent pipeline of relevant candidates, keep the process moving, and give the team enough context to make good hiring decisions. Over time, you become increasingly confident in identifying people who have the skills, mindset, and commitment to thrive at Facelove.



Apply



Send us your CV, LinkedIn profile and any materials showing you are the right fit for the role, along with a short note about why you’re interested in talent acquisition and Facelove Cosmetics.

I'm an entrepreneur who runs several online businesses, and I'm looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to work directly with me and become a key part of my day-to-day operations.



My biggest need is simple:



I need someone who can help keep me organized and make sure important things don't fall through the cracks.



There are always multiple projects, meetings, ideas, deadlines, messages, and tasks happening at the same time. I'm looking for someone who is naturally organized, follows up without being reminded, keeps track of details, and helps me stay focused on what needs my attention.



This is a long-term position. I'm looking for someone I can build a strong working relationship with and gradually trust with more responsibility over time.



What You'll Primarily Help Me With



Most of your work will involve:



Keeping my tasks, priorities, deadlines, and follow-ups organized

Maintaining my master task list in Notion

Taking tasks from messages, calls, voice notes, meetings, and screenshots and making sure they are tracked

Following up on things that are still outstanding

Helping coordinate projects across several businesses

Making sure I know what needs my attention each day

Joining a short daily call with me to review priorities

Organizing meeting notes and turning conversations into action items

Researching questions and giving me concise summaries

Keeping important documents and information organized

Flagging deadlines, blockers, or things I may have forgotten

Giving me a short update at the end of the day on what was completed and what is still open



You won't be expected to know everything on day one.



I'll teach you how my businesses operate, how I like things organized, and the systems we use.



Who I'm Looking For



Previous professional Executive Assistant experience is required.



You should have at least 1 year of experience directly supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, business owner, or senior executive.



More importantly, I'm looking for someone who is:



Extremely organized

Proactive

Reliable

Detail-oriented

Resourceful

A strong communicator

Excellent in spoken and written English

Comfortable managing many unrelated tasks at once

Able to work independently

Good at following up without being reminded

Comfortable asking good questions when something is unclear

A fast learner



One of the most important qualities I'm looking for is resourcefulness.



When you don't know how to do something, I want your first reaction to be:



"Let me look into it and see if I can figure it out."



AI, Marketing & E-Commerce



You do not need to be a marketer, media buyer, or AI expert.



However, my businesses involve a lot of:



AI and ChatGPT/Claude

Digital marketing

Google Ads and Meta Ads

E-commerce

Shopify

Business operations



So you'll naturally get exposure to these areas while working with me.



If you already have experience with any of them, that's great, but it is not required.



I'm happy to teach the right person.



For someone who is curious and wants to learn, this role can become a great opportunity to develop skills in AI, marketing, e-commerce, business operations, reporting, and project management.



Tools



We use tools such as:



Notion

Google Workspace

Google Sheets

Slack

ChatGPT

Claude



You do not need previous experience with every tool. If you're intelligent and comfortable with technology, you can learn them.



What You Can Expect From Me



You'll work directly with me and communicate with me regularly.



At first, I'll spend more time explaining how I work, my businesses, and what I need from you.



Over time, my goal is for you to become increasingly independent.



I don't want to micromanage someone forever. I want to develop a working relationship where you understand how I operate, recognize what needs to happen, and can increasingly take things off my plate.



You'll also have the opportunity to learn a lot about entrepreneurship, digital marketing, e-commerce, AI, advertising, and running online businesses.



Compensation & Growth



Starting compensation is around $70 USD per month, full-time.



This is not necessarily a hard maximum.



I'm willing to pay more for someone with stronger Executive Assistant experience, excellent English and communication skills, or particularly relevant experience.



There is also significant opportunity to earn more over time as you become more capable, independent, and valuable in the role.



I'm looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, not just another short-term VA job.



Schedule



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.



You must be comfortable working hours that overlap substantially with U.S. Eastern Time.



Please only apply if this schedule genuinely works for you long term.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your résumé

A short introduction telling me about your Executive Assistant experience

A 2–3 minute video introduction answering:

Who have you supported as an Executive Assistant?

What were your main responsibilities?

How do you personally keep track of many tasks and follow-ups at the same time?

Why do you think you'd be a good fit for this position?



Please speak naturally. Do not read an AI-generated script.

title: Executive Assistant / Project Coordinator to Founder | Organization + AI + Marketing | Work From Home
description:
Full-Time Remote | Philippines | Starting at ₱40,000/Month | U.S. Eastern Time Hours | Permanent Work From Home



About the Role



I'm an entrepreneur managing several online businesses, and I'm looking for a highly organized, intelligent, and resourceful Executive Assistant / Project Coordinator to work directly alongside me full-time.



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position focused mainly on calendar management, travel booking, or basic administrative work.



The most important part of this role is organization, follow-through, and keeping multiple priorities moving at the same time.



I have several businesses, projects, meetings, advertising accounts, ideas, deadlines, and tasks moving at once. I need someone who genuinely enjoys bringing order to that environment, keeping track of details, following up on loose ends, making sure nothing falls through the cracks, and helping me stay focused on what needs to happen next.



This is not an entry-level Virtual Assistant position.



You must already have professional experience working as an Executive Assistant or Executive Virtual Assistant and understand the fundamentals of supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or senior executive.



I will teach you my businesses, advertising, reporting systems, processes, and how I use AI. I am not expecting you to already know everything.



What I care about most is finding someone who is extremely organized, smart, proactive, reliable, resourceful, communicates well, learns quickly, and wants to grow into a much larger role over time.



Required Experience



Prior Executive Assistant experience is required.



You must have:



At least 1 year of professional experience working as an Executive Assistant, Executive Virtual Assistant, or in a very similar role.

Experience directly supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, business owner, or senior executive.

Experience managing multiple tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, and priorities.

Strong written and spoken English.

Experience using task-management, project-management, calendar, or collaboration tools.

Experience working independently and communicating directly with an executive.



2+ years of Executive Assistant experience is preferred, particularly if you have supported an entrepreneur, founder, agency owner, or executive managing multiple projects or businesses.



What You'll Primarily Do

Executive Organization & Task Management



This is the most important part of the job.



You will help make sure my priorities, tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, and open projects are organized and visible.



Responsibilities include:



Maintain and continuously update my master task list in Notion.

Capture tasks from messages, meetings, voice notes, screenshots, and conversations.

Keep priorities, deadlines, statuses, next steps, and open items organized.

Maintain your own task list and keep me updated on what you are working on.

Help prepare a short daily list of what needs my attention.

Make sure important deadlines, commitments, and follow-ups are not forgotten.

Join a short daily call with me to review priorities and outstanding work.

Keep Google Calendar updated when meetings, deadlines, or important commitments need to be reflected there.

Flag anything that is blocked, overdue, missing information, or requires my input.

Provide a short end-of-day update covering what was completed, what remains open, and what should happen next.



The goal is simple:



Important things should not disappear because I forgot to follow up on them.





Project Coordination



You will also help keep projects moving across several different businesses.



This may include:



Track projects, owners, deadlines, statuses, and next actions.

Follow up on assigned work and make sure projects continue moving.

Keep project documentation current.

Identify missing information or blockers preventing something from being completed.

Organize information so I can quickly understand what is happening without digging through messages and documents.

Keep track of several unrelated projects without losing context.

Make sure action items from meetings make their way into our task system.

Help turn rough ideas into organized next steps.

Follow up with me or other team members when something important is still outstanding.



I will provide direction and context.



Your job is to help turn that direction into organized execution.





Meetings, Research & Documentation



A lot of important information comes through meetings, calls, messages, and conversations.



You may:



Review meeting transcripts and AI-generated notes.

Extract decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and important follow-ups.

Update Notion after meetings.

Prepare concise meeting summaries.

Keep important documentation organized and easy to find.

Research clearly assigned business questions, competitors, products, software, or other topics.

Compare options and summarize your findings.

Prepare background information before meetings or decisions.

Use good judgment to give me the important information instead of sending large amounts of unorganized research.

Marketing & Paid Advertising Exposure



I work heavily in digital marketing, e-commerce, and paid advertising.



Because of that, this role will gradually get exposure to:



Google Ads

Meta Ads

E-commerce

Shopify

Landing pages

Marketing analytics

Advertising creative

Performance marketing

Conversion optimization



Prior media-buying experience is not required.



If you have experience working for a digital marketing agency, e-commerce company, marketing team, or around Google Ads or Meta Ads, that is a strong plus.



If you do not, I can teach you.



Initially, I may train you to:



Check advertising accounts using a simple checklist.

Review basic metrics such as spend, revenue, conversions, ROAS, CPA/CAC, and other KPIs.

Update daily and weekly reporting.

Compare current performance with previous periods.

Prepare screenshots and account information before I review campaigns.

Flag unusual changes or potential problems for me to investigate.

Maintain a log of important advertising changes.

Help organize marketing projects and creative work.



You are not expected to independently manage advertising campaigns when you start.



If you are interested, analytical, and learn quickly, there will be opportunities to learn much more about media buying and performance marketing over time.



AI, ChatGPT & Claude



AI will be an important part of how we work.



You should be comfortable with technology and preferably already have some experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools.



You do not need to be an AI expert.



I can teach you how I use AI. What matters more is that you are curious, willing to experiment, and interested in becoming very good at using these tools.



You may use AI to help:



Research unfamiliar topics.

Organize messy information.

Analyze information and reports.

Summarize meetings and documents.

Draft emails and written communication.

Create first drafts of LinkedIn posts, newsletters, and other marketing content.

Improve processes and workflows.

Turn rough notes or ideas into organized work.

Learn unfamiliar topics faster.



I do not want someone who blindly copies and pastes whatever ChatGPT produces.



You should be willing to think, review the output, fact-check important details, improve weak answers, and make sure the final work actually solves the assignment.



The Person I'm Looking For



This section matters more to me than having the perfect résumé.



Extremely Organized



You naturally create structure.



You keep track of deadlines, details, follow-ups, next steps, and unfinished work without needing someone to constantly remind you.



You should genuinely enjoy keeping things organized.



Intelligent and a Fast Learner



You can learn unfamiliar software, businesses, processes, and concepts quickly.



You do not need every new task explained five different times before you understand it.



Resourceful



When you do not know how to do something, your first instinct should be:



"Let me look into this and see if I can figure it out."



You research, use the tools available to you, make a reasonable attempt, and then ask intelligent questions if you are still blocked.



Proactive



You do not need to be told every tiny next step.



If something obvious needs to happen, you notice it.



If an important deadline is approaching, I should not have to be the person reminding you about it.



Detail-Oriented



You notice missing information, inconsistencies, errors, unfinished tasks, and things that do not make sense.



Excellent at Managing Multiple Priorities



You can move between several businesses and unrelated projects during the same day while still knowing where everything stands.



Strong Communicator



Excellent written and spoken English is important.



You should be able to take complicated information and communicate it clearly and concisely.



Reliable and Responsive



If you say something will be completed, I should be able to trust that it will be completed or that you will tell me immediately if something is preventing it.



Comfortable Working Closely With a Founder



You should be comfortable with frequent communication, changing priorities, rough ideas, and occasionally receiving incomplete instructions.



You should be able to create structure from that information rather than becoming overwhelmed by it.



Curious



You should be genuinely interested in learning about business, AI, digital marketing, e-commerce, systems, and entrepreneurship.



Comfortable With Feedback



You will receive feedback, especially while learning how I work.



I want someone who uses feedback to improve quickly.



Strong Plus, But Not Required



Experience with any of the following would make you a stronger candidate:



2+ years of Executive Assistant experience.

Experience supporting an entrepreneur or founder.

Project Coordinator or Operations Coordinator experience.

Digital marketing agency experience.

E-commerce experience.

Google Ads or Meta Ads exposure.

Shopify.

Notion.

Google Sheets.

Google Workspace.

Slack.

ChatGPT.

Claude.

Marketing reporting or analytics.



You do not need all of these.



I care much more about having a strong Executive Assistant foundation and the right personality than checking every technical box.



What Working With Me Will Be Like



You will work directly with me and communicate with me frequently throughout the day.



There will be more communication at the beginning while you learn the businesses, my priorities, and how I work.



You should be comfortable receiving information through:



Messages

Calls

Voice notes

Screenshots

Documents

Spreadsheets

Meeting transcripts



Sometimes my instructions may begin as a rough idea rather than a perfectly organized assignment.



Part of becoming excellent at this role will be learning how to take that messy information and turn it into organized action.



I do not want to micromanage someone forever.



The goal is for you to gradually learn how I work, become more independent, and take increasing responsibility off my plate.



Growth Opportunity



I'm looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, not simply another temporary VA job.



For the right person, this role can grow significantly.



Depending on your interests and abilities, you may gradually learn and take on more responsibility involving:



Paid advertising

Marketing analytics

E-commerce

AI workflows

Content creation

Business operations

Process improvement

Project ownership

Reporting and analysis

Systems and automation



Someone who becomes highly valuable, reliable, and increasingly independent can grow into a much larger role with significantly greater responsibility.



Compensation can grow with that responsibility and demonstrated value.



Compensation



Starting compensation: ₱40,000 PHP per month, full-time.



This is a starting point, not necessarily a hard maximum.



I am willing to offer a higher starting salary for an exceptional candidate with stronger Executive Assistant experience, particularly relevant experience, excellent communication, or demonstrated ability.



There is also meaningful opportunity for compensation growth over time as you become more capable and take on additional responsibility.



Schedule



Full-time, 40 hours per week.



This position requires reliable working-hour overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable consistently maintaining this schedule.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your résumé.

A short written introduction explaining why you think you would be a strong fit for this specific role.

A 3 to 5 minute Loom or video introduction answering the following questions:

Tell me briefly about yourself and your recent Executive Assistant experience.

Who have you directly supported in the past, and what were your main responsibilities?

How do you personally keep track of many tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, and projects at the same time?

Give me an example of something important that could have fallen through the cracks, but you caught it or followed up on it.

Give me an example of something you had to learn quickly without already knowing how to do it.

How do you currently use ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools?

Have you had any exposure to digital marketing, paid advertising, e-commerce, or working with an entrepreneur? If yes, tell me about it. This experience is not required.



Please speak naturally.



Do not read an AI-generated script.



I care much more about seeing how you naturally communicate and think than receiving a perfectly polished answer.



Finally, at the very end of your application, write:



"I read the entire job description."



Applications that do not include this sentence will not be considered.
