title: Remote Dental Scheduler
description:
Company: Smile Group

Position: Dental Scheduler / Patient Coordinator

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time EST time

Compensation: $2.50 USD/hour base pay + $2.00 USD per qualifying appointment scheduled



About the Position



Smile Group is looking for a motivated, confident, and knowledgeable Dental Scheduler to join our team remotely.



This is not a traditional call-center position.



Our schedulers are an important part of each dental office and are often the first point of contact for our patients. You will work directly with our dental teams to answer incoming calls, make outbound calls, schedule patients, answer common dental questions, and help keep our doctors’ and hygienists’ schedules full.



We are specifically looking for candidates who already have dental knowledge and dental scheduling experience or a strong understanding of dental procedures, terminology, and appointment types.



Fluent English and Spanish is required for this position.



Compensation



The compensation structure is designed to reward performance:



Base Pay: $2.50 USD per hour

Performance Bonus: $2.00 USD per qualifying appointment you successfully schedule



This means your earning potential is directly connected to your performance. The more successful appointments you create, the more you can earn.



For performance bonuses, appointments must meet the company’s qualification requirements, including patient attendance/completion when applicable.



We want motivated schedulers who are excited by the opportunity to earn additional compensation by helping keep our offices productive and our schedules full.



Main Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be to answer incoming patient calls and make outbound calls to schedule patients.



You will work with multiple scheduling opportunities, including:



New patient calls and inquiries

New patient scheduling

Patient reactivation

Patients who missed previous appointments

Patients who canceled and need to reschedule

Patients due for hygiene/cleaning appointments

Patients who completed SRP and are due for periodontal maintenance

Patients with treatment plans who have not scheduled

Patients who have already paid for treatment but do not have an appointment

Following up with patients to help fill openings in the schedule

Confirming and maintaining productive schedules

Helping the offices work toward zero missed calls

Dental Knowledge Is Required



This position requires more than excellent phone skills.



You must be able to speak confidently with patients about common dental procedures and appointments.



For example, you should understand or be able to confidently explain:



The difference between a regular prophylaxis/prophy and Scaling and Root Planing (SRP)

Why a patient may need SRP instead of a regular cleaning

What a patient can expect during common dental appointments

How many appointments may be required for a crown

Basic steps involved in crown treatment

Basic implant treatment processes

Pre-operative and post-operative appointments related to implants

Hygiene and periodontal maintenance appointments

Common dental terminology

How to schedule different dental procedures appropriately



We do not expect the scheduler to diagnose patients or answer questions that require a dentist or clinical provider. However, you should be able to confidently handle common patient questions without unnecessarily transferring every call.



Our goal is minimum unnecessary escalations and minimum unnecessary transfers to office managers.



Language Requirements



English is required.



Because you will be speaking with patients throughout the day, you must be able to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.



You should be comfortable:



Answering patient calls in English

Explaining dental appointments and procedures clearly

Handling patient questions confidently

Communicating professionally through phone calls, text messages, and other patient communication channels

Understanding patients with different speaking styles and accents

Providing a high level of customer service in English



Spanish is a plus. Bilingual English/Spanish candidates are encouraged to apply, but Spanish is not required for consideration.



You Are Part of the Dental Office



We do not want our patients to feel like they are speaking with an outside call center.



You should never approach a patient conversation with:



“This is the call center. Let me transfer you to the office.”



You are part of the office team.



We want our patients to feel that they are speaking directly with a knowledgeable member of their dental office who understands their needs and can help them.



The scheduler is one of the most important roles in our organization because you:



Create the appointments that fill the doctors’ schedules

Help patients receive the treatment they need

Create the patient's first impression of our practice

Help prevent missed opportunities

Support the doctors, hygienists, managers, and clinical teams

Help maintain healthy and productive schedules

What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate will have:



Fluent spoken and written English — required

Spanish — a plus

Previous dental scheduling, dental receptionist, dental call center, or dental patient coordinator experience

Good knowledge of dental terminology

Understanding of common dental procedures

Experience scheduling dental appointments

Strong customer service skills

Confidence speaking with patients

Excellent telephone etiquette

Ability to explain information clearly and professionally

Strong follow-up skills

Ability to handle objections and encourage patients to schedule

High motivation and a performance-driven mindset

Ability to work independently

Reliability and consistency

Strong attention to detail

Ability to learn our systems and protocols quickly

A positive, team-oriented attitude

Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:



Answer calls consistently

Help us achieve as close to zero missed calls as possible

Create quality appointments

Convert patient inquiries into scheduled appointments

Follow up consistently with unscheduled patients

Keep schedules full

Communicate professionally with patients

Reduce unnecessary transfers

Understand dental appointment types

Work as a true member of the dental office team



This is a great opportunity for someone who already understands dentistry and enjoys speaking with patients, scheduling treatment, and working toward performance goals.



How to Apply



Please send your application to:





Please include:

Your resume

Your previous dental experience

The dental software you have used

Your experience scheduling dental procedures

A short explanation of the difference between a prophy and an SRP

Your experience handling incoming and outbound patient calls

Your English proficiency level

Whether you speak Spanish and your proficiency level, if applicable

Your available working hours

Your internet speed and computer specifications



Important: Strong dental knowledge and fluent English are important requirements for this position. Applicants without sufficient dental knowledge may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a real part of the Smile Group dental team, provide an excellent patient experience, and take advantage of a performance-based compensation structure with the opportunity to increase their earnings through successful scheduling.

title: Customer Support Manager (US Payroll, HR & Benefits Support Team)
description:
Customer Support Manager | Remote | Full Time

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time

(8:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine time; 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM from November to March)



People who call our support line usually need a clear answer about something that matters to them: a paycheck, a benefit, a deadline, or an HR question. We're looking for a manager who gets that and can lead a team that answers with accuracy, urgency, and care.



ABOUT COLLABPEO

collabPEO is a US-based PEO (Professional Employer Organization). We handle payroll, employee benefits, HR support, compliance, and risk management for businesses, so they can focus on running their company.



THE ROLE

You'll lead a remote support team of about 10 to 20 people who answer questions from our clients (business owners and managers) and their employees. This is a people-leadership and operations role. You'll stay close enough to the calls to spot recurring issues, but your main job is building a strong team, keeping the queue covered, setting clear expectations, and improving the service experience.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead, coach, and develop a remote support team of 10 to 20 people

- Own daily operations: staffing, scheduling, and queue coverage for the full 8 AM to 5 PM ET window

- Set performance targets and track call quality, response time, resolution, CSAT, abandonment, and schedule adherence

- Run one-on-ones, team huddles, call reviews, and coaching sessions with direct, useful feedback

title: Bookkeeping SME / Senior Bookkeeper
description:
KINDLY READ EVERYTHING BEFORE APPLYING, YOU SHOULD KNOW WHAT YOU ARE APPLYING FOR. 



Position Overview



We are looking for an experienced Bookkeeping SME / Senior Bookkeeper with strong hands-on U.S. bookkeeping and accounting experience. This role requires someone who can independently handle complex bookkeeping situations, troubleshoot accounting discrepancies, and provide quality control and guidance to junior bookkeepers.



The ideal candidate is highly proficient in QuickBooks Online, understands reconciliation and financial reporting, and can explain the reasoning behind accounting decisions. This is a hands-on SME role focused on accuracy, problem-solving, client support, and reviewing the work of junior bookkeepers.



Key Responsibilities

- Bookkeeping & Accounting

- Perform and review day-to-day bookkeeping activities for U.S.-based clients

- Review and categorize financial transactions accurately

- Perform bank and credit card reconciliations

- Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies

- Review general ledger accounts and financial transactions for accuracy

- Identify incorrect, duplicate, missing, or misclassified transactions

- Assist with month-end close and financial reporting

- Review Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reports

- Analyze significant fluctuations and explain financial results

- Support accurate and complete client financial records



QuickBooks & Accounting Systems

- Work extensively in QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop

- Troubleshoot complex bookkeeping and transaction issues within QuickBooks

- Review transaction history and audit trails when discrepancies occur

- Determine appropriate corrections while following client accounting policies

- Handle situations involving duplicate payments, bills, checks, credits, and reconciliations

- Review integrations and imported transactions from platforms such as e-commerce or POS systems

- Reconcile external platforms and transaction data before recording information in QuickBooks



SME & Quality Control

- Review the work completed by junior bookkeepers

- Perform quality checks before financial information is submitted to clients

- Identify recurring errors and determine the appropriate corrective action

- Provide guidance, coaching, and one-on-one support to junior bookkeepers

- Document performance issues and provide factual feedback to management

- Help establish and maintain accurate bookkeeping processes and standards

- Step in and resolve complex bookkeeping issues when needed

- Take accountability for the accuracy and quality of bookkeeping work



Preferred Experience

- Experience working as a Senior Bookkeeper, Bookkeeping SME, Accounting SME, or similar role

- Experience supporting multiple U.S. clients simultaneously

- Experience with QuickBooks Desktop in addition to QuickBooks Online

- Experience with e-commerce, POS, construction, professional services, or law firm accounting

- Experience reconciling Shopify, Amazon, Square, or similar platforms with QuickBooks

- Experience with month-end close

- Experience preparing financial analysis or fluctuation reports

- Experience mentoring or reviewing junior bookkeepers

- CPA firm or accounting firm experience



The ideal candidate is not simply someone who knows how to enter transactions into QuickBooks. They should be able to look at an accounting problem, investigate what happened, determine the appropriate treatment, and explain their reasoning.



They should also be comfortable serving as a technical resource for junior bookkeepers, reviewing their work, identifying errors, and providing clear recommendations to management.

description:

HighGrowth.io builds outbound sales teams for founder-led, bootstrapped, B2B companies ($500K to $5M ARR) in the US and Europe. We need an additional Sales Team Implementation Manager to help us scale.

 

In this role, you’ll lead and manage client sales team implementations end-to-end, while partnering closely with our founder on strategy, priorities, and continuous improvement of our outbound playbook. 



This is a high-ownership seat: part client delivery, part sales operations oversight, and a key right hand to a strategic executive.



The ideal candidate must be a strong sales leader, but also must be able to work with and alongside other strong personalities. Why? 



Your sales leadership experience will allow you to slot directly into this role, since you already know the general management principles of dialing and sales teams. However, you'll be following the HighGrowth.io playbook and working with the HighGrowth.io founder to adjust that playbook to the realities of the specific client.



Additionally, you'll be interacting with the founder (or founders) on the client side. If it's not already clear, bootstrapped founders tend to have very strong personalities.



What You’ll Be Doing:

 • Lead outbound sales implementations for a HighGrowth.io client.

 • Translate our outbound sales playbook into practical hiring, onboarding, metrics, and performance systems for the client.

 • Directly manage offshore dialers and salespeople, maintaining accountability through scorecards and simple performance rhythms.

 • Run performance reviews with the client team, assess progress, and work with the HighGrowth.io founder to adjust strategy as needed.

 • Work closely with our founder on non-client-facing founder priorities: process upgrades, internal projects, and playbook refinements.

 • Keep implementation projects organized, including timelines, deliverables, handoffs, and documentation.

 • Coordinate meetings, reporting, and other lightweight activities that keep delivery running smoothly.



We’re Looking For Someone Who Has:

 • Four-plus years of outbound B2B sales management experience, as a leader or coach.

 • Strong operational discipline: you like metrics, routines, and making performance visible.

 • Confidence running multiple workstreams without dropping details.

title: Market Operations Associate
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website: 



Position: Market Operations Associate

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)

Salary Range: USD 950 - 1,200 / Month

Benefit: 10 PTO and HMO after the probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide



Job Summary:



Market Operations keeps our markets running: enough verified drivers on the road, every trip assigned before the day begins, and every trip completed on time. You'll own a piece of that and be measured on it. This is a decision-making role, not a scripted one — you'll make calls, act, and explain your reasoning afterward. If you're looking for phone-based client support with defined procedures, our Client Support Specialist opening is the better fit.

How your responsibilities are assigned



The responsibilities below cover everything Market Operations does across five areas. You will not be responsible for all of them.



During the hiring process, we'll evaluate where your strengths fit best, and you'll start in one area. Your assignment is confirmed before you accept the offer, so you'll know exactly what you're taking on. Over time, you'll be cross-trained into more.



Read this as the map of the team you're joining, and your starting point within it.



Responsibilities:

1. If assigned to Driver Onboarding & Activation

• Make fast first contact with new driver applicants and guide them through the application

• Run onboarding interviews, group and 1:1, and d
 who advances

• Review driver documents for accuracy and compliance, and coach applicants through corrections

• Coordinate background checks and screenings, and follow up until cleared

• Run activation calls so new drivers are confident on the app before their first trip

• Keep the roster current: expiration outreach, reactivation checks, and removing inactive drivers



2. If assigned to Dispatch & Scheduling

• Build driver schedules and assign trips against them

• Sweep the current week for schedule gaps and fill them before trips go uncovered

• Work inside our AI-assisted dispatching tools, producing and acting on the daily output

• Flag where the tooling gets it wrong so it improves

• Notify drivers of schedule changes



3. If assigned to OTP Specialist

• Monitor on-time performance live and intervene before a trip goes late, not after

• Own urgent trip reassignments end to end: the decision, driver contact, and resolution

• Keep clients informed before they have to ask

• Step in when leads are tied up so nothing waits in a queue



4. If assigned to Routing Specialist

• Build and adjust routes for efficiency and reliability

• Make sure drivers activate GPS well ahead of pickup

• Chase and coach drivers who don't, before it becomes a data gap

• Protect billing and claims accuracy by keeping trip data complete



5. If assigned to Market Associate

• Cover a portion of all three areas above in a newer or smaller market

• Shift week to week toward whatever is currently limiting the market

• Flag early which area is about to break



Every Market Operations Associate, in every area

• Own your daily and weekly targets, and know where you stand without being asked

• Resolve problems in your area rather than handing them off

• Escalate what's genuinely above your authority, with what you've already tried and what you recommend

• Keep driver and trip records accurate in every system you touch

• Improve the procedures you work from, and document the ones that don't exist yet

• Cross-train as backup on one adjacent area

• Bring us patterns, not just i



Requirements:



Required

• 2-4 years in operations, dispatch, logistics, or program coordination, a role where you owned an outcome, not just a queue

• Sound judgment without a script. Much of this work has no procedure for the situation in front of you

• Comfort with tradeoffs. Some days you can cover one trip or the other, not both, and you'll need to d
 quickly and defend the call

• Comfort being measured daily. You should want the scoreboard, not avoid it

• Ability to hold several threads at once and switch between them without dropping any

• Strong written and verbal communication — most areas involve daily calls with drivers

• Composure when things break. Some days are interrupt-driven and won't go as planned

• Detail accuracy where a missed date or wrong record has real consequences

• Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to learn new tools quickly

• Willingness to work ET hours, including weekend or holiday rotation depending on assignment

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet space for video calls



Preferred

• NEMT, healthcare transportation, or other regulated service experience

• Dispatch, fleet, or last-mile operations background

• Applicant tracking or recruiting platform experience

• Experience running group interviews or high-volume onboarding

• Experience with AI-assisted operational tooling

title: AI Video Creator  - Character Consistency (Short-Form Reels)
description:
We run a faceless short-form video channel on Instagram and TikTok built around

one recurring AI character — an elderly woman who gives simple health advice.

We post 5-7 videos a week, 45-90 seconds each.



We give you the script and the master character images. You build the rest.



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- The finished script for each video

- The recorded voiceover file

- The master character sheet: her face, her clothing, her hands, her locations

- Brand guidelines: caption style, pacing, what the channel does and does not do

- Server access and paid tool accounts. You pay for nothing.



WHAT YOU BUILD

- D
 the shots. Read the script and work out what the viewer should see.

- Write your own image prompts and generate every shot from the master sheet,

 keeping the character identical across every video we have ever posted

- Build and maintain the ComfyUI workflows or other tools for image generation, animation and

 lip-sync

- Animate the shots and run the lip-sync against our voice file

- Edit in CapCut or your editor of choice: cuts, burned-in karaoke captions,

 pinned banner, audio mix

- Export vertical 1080x1920 and post it

- Keep clean, organised folders so any asset from any video can be found later



REQUIRED

- Real experience keeping ONE character consistent across many generations.

 This is the whole job. If her face drifts between videos, the channel dies.

- AI video generation: WAN, Hailuo/MiniMax, Kling, Runway, Veo — any of them

- Lip-sync tools: InfiniteTalk, Hedra, Sync.so, Kling Avatar, LatentSync

- Strong short-form editing, especially burned-in captions and audio timing

- You can write your own prompts in English and explain why a generation failed

- Reliable internet, your own computer, and hours overlapping Europe (CET)



NICE TO HAVE

- LoRA training

- Instagram Reels / TikTok posting and scheduling experience

- Photography or cinematography background



THE PART THAT MATTERS MOST

These tools fail constantly. Hands come out wrong. The character freezes. The

lip-sync smears. The model ignores half your prompt.



We are not looking for someone who sends the first output and calls it done. We

are looking for someone who sees what is wrong, knows why, changes one thing,

and runs it again. That instinct is worth more to us than any tool on your CV.



You will own this end to end. We will give you honest feedback and we expect the

same back.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word GINGER so we know you read this.



Then answer:

1. Send links to two short vertical videos you made with AI tools — ideally

 with the same character in both.

2. Describe one time an AI generation kept coming out wrong and what you

 changed to fix it.



Applications without the word GINGER will not be read.

This is not a basic product uploading position.



You will often receive only an AliExpress or Alibaba product link.



From that point, you are expected to independently research the product, find competitors, verify product information, source the best available content, determine the strongest customer benefits and angles, improve the visuals and build the complete product page in Shopify using GemPages.



What You Will Be Responsible For

• Comparing different supplier listings to verify specifications, variants and product information

 which benefits to focus on

title: Video editor for Ads!
description:
We're a marketing agency running Meta ads for chiropractic clinics in the US. Our ads are mostly raw footage: patient testimonials, treatment demos, clinic owners talking to camera. Our job is to turn that into ads people actually watch.



We need someone part time to edit these, 15 hours a week.



**The work**



-Cut long raw footage into short ads, usually 30 to 90 seconds

-Captions, b-roll, simple graphics, music. Nothing flashy

-Produce multiple versions of the same footage with different openings so we can test them

-Light cleanup: audio levels, color, removing dead air and stumbles



**The part that matters most: Finding the hook.**



Most of the raw footage we get is 1 to 15 minutes long. somewhere in there is one sentence or moment that makes a stranger stop scrolling.



It might be the moment the patient says what was actually wrong with them. It might be the moment they get emotional. Or it could a blunt line the clinic owner didn't realize was the best thing they said.



Your job is to watch the whole thing and find those moments. If you can do that well, we will train you on everything else.



What we're looking for



-Strong CapCut familiarity. That's our main tool

-You watch a lot of short form content and have opinions about what works and what doesn't

-Fast turnaround on simple edits, since we test a lot of variations

-Clear written English

-Reliable. You'll set your own deadlines but you need to hit them. :)



You do not need to be a Premiere or After Effects expert. Direct response ads do not need motion graphics. They need the right 2 seconds at the front and the right 5 seconds following that.



**The details**



-15 hours per week, flexible schedule. Deadlines matter, exact hours don't

-$400 per month USD

-Shortlisted applicants get a small paid test edit before any offer. We do not ask anyone to work for free

-You will work directly with our primary PH based head of ads



**To apply**



Watch this video: 



Send a Loom (or similar screen recording) under 5 minutes with:



1. A short introduction of yourself and what you edit with



2. The timestamps you would use as ad hooks from that video, and for each one, say out loud why you picked it. Two or three is enough if they're good ones



3. One example of your own editing work



ALL APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO WILL BE DISREGARDED

title: AI Video Creator & Video Editor (Real Estate / Home Design)
description:

About Us

Hykal Homes is a woman-led residential design-build firm based in Raleigh, North Carolina, USA. We design and build homes, renovate existing properties, and provide design services to homeowners, builders and developers. We have completed 100+ residential projects, and we have a large library of project footage waiting to be turned into content that sells.



The Role

We're looking for a creative, marketing-minded video editor who can do two things well:



Turn our raw project footage into scroll-stopping stories for social media and paid ads.

Create high-quality AI-generated videos to fill gaps in our ad portfolio.



This is not just an editing job. We want someone who understands why people stop scrolling, what makes them trust a brand, and what makes them click. You'll work directly with the founder and help shape how Hykal Homes shows up online.



What You'll Do



Video editing: Edit raw footage (before/afters, construction progress, walkthroughs, client stories, founder talking-head videos) into short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok,

Cut longer videos into multiple short clips, hooks and teasers.

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

title: Client Services Coordinator
description:
We are a performance marketing agency based outside Atlanta, Georgia. We run paid search, SEO, paid social, programmatic, and web services for small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S. Our clients trust us to move their numbers, and staying close to their accounts is how we keep that trust.



We are hiring a Client Services Coordinator to help us stay close to every client.



What This Role Is



This is an entry-level, client-facing support role. You will start from the ground up. We will train you on our clients, our process, and our tools. As you grow, you will take on more ownership of the accounts you support.



You will not be running ad campaigns yourself. Your job is to keep our clients organized, informed, and well cared for. You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks and every client feels taken care of.



This is a role for someone who wants to learn and grow with an agency. What matters most to us is not what you already know, but your written and spoken English, your attention to detail, and your willingness to be taught.



What You Will Be Doing



Learn every account. Get to know the status, goals, deliverables, and open items for each client. Over time, you become the person who can speak to any account at a moment's notice.



Join client calls. Attend calls alongside the team, take clear and thorough notes in real time, and track every decision and action item.



Write call summaries and next steps. After each call, send a clean, well-written recap to the client covering what was discussed, what was d
, and what happens next, with clear owners and dates.



Send finalized reports. Deliver monthly performance reports to clients once they have been reviewed and finalized internally, with a short, clear note framing the results.



Assemble client-facing materials. Put together decks, recaps, onboarding documents, and other materials that keep clients informed and confident.



Keep communication tight. Respond to client questions promptly, chase down answers internally, and make sure follow-ups actually get followed up on.



Be the connective tissue. Serve as the organized link between our specialists (search, social, SEO, web) and the client, so everyone stays aligned.



What We Are Looking For



Exceptional written English. Your emails and summaries read as polished, professional, and native-level. Grammar, tone, and clarity are second nature.



Exceptional spoken English. You are clear, confident, and easy to understand on live client calls with U.S. business owners.



Meticulous attention to detail. You catch the small things, keep accurate notes, and never let an action item slip.



Strong organization. You can hold the details of many clients in order at once and always know the current state of each.



Eager to learn. You are coachable, take feedback well, and want to build a career in client services. We will train you. You bring the willingness.



Proactive and reliable. You follow through without being chased and take real ownership of what you are given.



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Experience in digital marketing, an agency, or client services / account management.



Familiarity with paid search, SEO, paid social, or web projects. Enough to follow the conversation, not to execute it.



Comfort with tools like Google Workspace, Slack, project management software, and reporting dashboards.



Details



Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, U.S. Eastern business hours. This means evening and overnight hours in the Philippines.

Type: Independent contractor, entry-level, with full training provided.

Location: Remote, based in the Philippines.

Reports to: Managing Director.

Requirements: Dependable internet connection and a quiet space for calls.



How to Apply



Answer these 3 things. Applications that do not include all 3 will not be reviewed.



A short introduction telling us why this role fits you. This is your first writing sample. We read it closely.

Your resume. Write a sample client email: You just finished a call with a client who runs a dental practice. On the call, you discussed their Google Ads performance from last month (leads were up 15% but cost per lead increased), agreed to test new ad copy next month, and the client asked about adding SEO services. Write the post-call summary email you would send to the client.

title: Roofing Admin Support
description:
About the role



This is not a pure Xactimate seat. Roughly 20 percent of the work is insurance estimating and supplementing. The other 80 percent is retail estimating, product sourcing, production coordination, and business support.



That mix is expected to move. Within the next 60 days it may shift further toward retail, or insurance volume may grow again if storm activity picks up. Whoever takes this seat needs to be comfortable with that, and genuinely interested in the wider business rather than one narrow task.



What you will do



Insurance estimating and supplements (about 20 percent)



Write Xactimate estimates from photos, Hover or EagleView reports, and field notes

Prepare supplements and rebuttals, and pursue them with carrier adjusters until approved

Escalate and follow up persistently rather than accepting a first denial

Prepare certificates of completion and closing documentation



Retail estimating and product sourcing



Build retail estimates from what the sales team brings back from the field

Research specialty products homeowners request, including products the company has not quoted before

Call distributors and manufacturers for pricing, labor norms, and lead times

Apply margins and return clean, decision-ready quotes to the sales team



Production and coordination



Schedule crews and jobs

Follow up with homeowners on build dates and job status

Order materials online

Track jobs through to completion



Business support



QuickBooks: invoices, company expenses, subcontractor payments

Keep job and financial records current and accurate



Growth work (commission eligible)



Recruit and vet labor crews

Prospect big box suppliers and commercial accounts to open new work

Learn to present and close over video, with training and coaching provided



AI and systems



Use AI daily as part of how you work, not occasionally

Learn the company's in-house bot and use it to move faster

Bring ideas back on how to streamline, automate, and increase output

What we are looking for



Experience



3 or more years writing Xactimate estimates and pursuing supplements with carriers

Xactimate Level 3 certification preferred

Hover or EagleView experience

Working knowledge of QuickBooks, or the ability to pick it up quickly

US home improvement or restoration background, roofing and siding especially

Strong spoken English and real confidence on the phone with adjusters, distributors, and homeowners



Attributes that matter more than the resume



Entrepreneurial. You look at the business and think about how it could grow, not only about the task in front of you.

Persistent. You treat a no as the beginning of the conversation. You will call, escalate, and follow up until you get an answer.

Broad. You want to learn the whole operation: estimating, sourcing, production, sales, back office.

Self-directed. You bring ideas and finish work without being chased.

Coachable. You want training, feedback, and the chance to get better at sales.



Setup



Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

A quiet, professional space for calls with US clients and carriers

Who this role is not for



Please do not apply if:



You want to write Xactimate estimates and nothing else. That is a real and valuable skill, but it is not this job.

You are uncomfortable pushing back on insurance adjusters or making repeated follow up calls.

You are not interested in learning sales, product sourcing, or the retail side of construction.

You want a fixed, unchanging scope of work.



This role rewards range and initiative. Someone who wants only one lane will be underused here, and will not enjoy it.



Why this seat is worth having



The scope is wide on purpose. The person in this seat will learn US retail construction sales, estimating, product sourcing, production, and AI-assisted operations, with commission on the revenue they help create and direct coaching from an owner who built the company from the ground up.

title: Expert YouTube Longform Video Editor
description:
We are looking for an expert-level YouTube Video Editor who can create premium, retention-focused long-form content for top creators and brands. This role is best suited for editors who understand high-quality YouTube storytelling in the style of channels such as Vox, Johnny Harris, Cleo Abram, and other documentary/explainer-style creators. We are not looking for basic editors, short-form-only editors, or editors who simply add cuts and captions. We are looking for someone with strong creative judgment, technical skill, and the ability to turn raw footage and direction into a polished, engaging, and thoughtful YouTube video. The ideal editor understands pacing, story structure, audience retention, visual clarity, motion graphics, sound design, and how every editing choice affects the viewer’s experience.



Responsibilities



Edit high-quality long-form YouTube videos for creators, brands, and educational content.

Build strong hooks that make viewers want to keep watching.

Shape raw footage into a clear and engaging story.

Use B-roll, archival footage, graphics, music, sound design, and visual references intentionally.

Create clean motion graphics, maps, text animations, callouts, and visual explanations when needed.

Improve pacing, flow, clarity, and retention throughout the video.

Follow creative direction while also bringing your own strong editorial judgment.

Apply feedback quickly and professionally.

Work with creative leads, producers, and post-production teams to meet high creative standards.

Deliver polished edits on time in a fast-moving YouTube-first environment.



Qualifications



Strong experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

Expert-level skill in Adobe Premiere Pro.

Expert-level skill in Adobe After Effects and motion graphics.

Good understanding of Photoshop or other Adobe Creative Suite tools.

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts.

Ability to create documentary, explainer, talking-head, educational, or creator-style edits.

Strong use of B-roll, archival footage, visual references, graphics, sound design, and music.

Understanding of audience retention, viewer engagement, and YouTube performance.

Experience editing high-performing or high-quality content for creators, agencies, brands, or media companies.

Ability to work with feedback, revisions, and tight deadlines.

Strong attention to detail and clean technical execution.

Reliable computer/workstation setup and strong internet connection.



This Role Is Not For



Entry-level editors.

Editors with only short-form reel experience.

Editors with only wedding, corporate, event, or basic social media editing experience.

Editors who are not comfortable with long-form YouTube content.

Editors who only follow instructions but do not bring creative judgment.

Editors who cannot work with feedback or tight deadlines.

Editors who do not have strong Premiere Pro and After Effects skills.



Benefits



Work from anywhere! We’re a 100% remote team.

A quarterly wellness reimbursement

20 days of paid time off annually.

12 additional holidays per year.

Unlimited sick and bereavement leave.

Working for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact.

Unlimited reimbursement on book purchases for self-education.

Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements.

Working directly with some of the largest brands on the planet.



Additionally, Dragonfruit is highly committed to offering all our team members opportunities for growth and mobility within the company. This could include moving up to Lead Short-Form or Long-Form Editor, Director of the Editing Department, Post-Production Supervisor, or even Creative Director or beyond! (Of course, all of these positions come with pay increases.)

?

If you're ready to join Dragonfruit and play a role in the future of YouTube, submit your application now!

title: GoHighLevel Builder, Paid 1-Week Trial, Then Ongoing
description:

The method is one global stylesheet with custom classes applied to native elements. You will also build a native enquiry form with conditional logic and consent checkboxes, the workflow behind it (pipeline, notifications, follow-up), a ScoreApp scorecard integration, and a global nav and footer.

A retreat operator: deposit checkout, payment plans,

* ERP systems

CONTROLLER

title: Bookkeeping / Accounting, US LLC for online business
description:
We run a marketing agency serving chiropractic clinics in the US. The company is a US LLC, and the books are in QuickBooks Online. They are currently behind and messy. We need someone to clean them up and then keep them clean.



This is a small, steady engagement. Roughly 3 hours a week once the cleanup is done. You likely have other similar businesses that you're working for, and that's a big plus. 



**Phase 1: the cleanup (fixed price project, about 3 weeks)**



-Around 50 transactions to categorize per month, March to present



-Reconnect the bank feed and import the missing period



-Reconcile Revolut Business (USD), Wise and Stripe against statements



-Handle the Stripe volume properly. Stripe pays out to our bank net of fees, and there are 400+ individual fee transactions sitting in the feed. 



-Clean up the chart of accounts so the P&L is actually readable



- Send us a list of the transactions you cannot categorize on your own, with your best guess on each



Phase 2: ongoing (monthly)



-Categorize and reconcile the month



-Deliver a P&L and balance sheet by the 5th the following month, with a short note on anything that looks off



-Flag questions & information needed as they come up, not in a pile at month end



**What we are looking for**



QuickBooks Online experience with US-based clients. ProAdvisor certification preferred



Comfortable with multi-currency and multiple accounts (Revolut, Wise, Stripe)



You know how payment processors work and how to avoid double counting payouts



You ask when you are not sure instead of guessing and burying it in Uncategorized Expense



Clear written English. Most of our communication will be written



You do not need to be a US tax preparer. Our annual filings are handled separately. Your job is clean books and a monthly P&L we can use.



**Compensation**



Phase 1: $400 fixed for the cleanup project

Phase 2: $120 per month ongoing



Shortlisted applicants get a small paid test task before any offer. We do not ask anyone to work for free



**To apply**



Reply with short VIDEO (
 preferred) answering these three questions. Please answer in your own words. Copied or AI-written answers are obvious and will be skipped. Short answers suffice we're looking for maybe 2-4 mins tops.



-How many years have you done QuickBooks Online for US clients, and are you ProAdvisor certified?



-We take payments through Stripe. Stripe deposits into our bank net of its fees, and the feed also contains 400+ individual fee transactions. How would you handle this so that revenue shows gross, fees show as an expense, and the deposits are not counted twice?



-Tell us about a set of books you inherited that were in bad shape. What was wrong and how did you work through it?



-Have you worked with online marketing agency businesses before? If so, please provide a name that we can look up.



Applications that DOES NOT CONTAIN A LOOM will be disregarded.

title: SHOPIFY B2B DEVELOPER

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a health ecommerce company running Meta ads across an international store.



We are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist who can research strong swipes, develop original angles, write direct-response copy, and guide video editors in producing effective video ads.



This is not a general social media or graphic-design position. You must understand ecommerce advertising, customer psychology, direct-response creative strategy, and how to turn research into concepts that can be tested and scaled.



## WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Research competitor ads, product pages, advertorials, reviews, customer pain points, and market trends.

- Find strong swipes using the Meta Ad Library and other reliable research sources.

- Evaluate swipes using signals such as reach, impressions, run duration, repetition, market relevance, and advertiser credibility.

- Turn research into original angles, hooks, offers, ad copy, and detailed creative briefs.

- Guide Video Editors and review whether their work follows the intended strategy.

- Create new concepts instead of repeatedly redesigning the same angle.

- Develop iterations of proven winners without losing the reason the original ad worked.

- Review performance with the media-buying team and use the results to plan the next concepts.

- Maintain an organized testing pipeline across assigned products and stores.

- Follow Meta compliance requirements for health, beauty, and wellness advertising.

- Report creative winners, failures, learnings, and next actions clearly.



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven Creative Strategist experience with ecommerce or dropshipping brands.

- Strong swipe-research and direct-response thinking.

- Able to explain why an ad may be working and how to turn that insight into an original concept.

- Strong understanding of angles, hooks, offers, customer awareness, and advertorial funnels.

- Comfortable writing ad copy and giving clear instructions to video editors.

- Able to use performance data to d
 what to iterate, stop, or replace.

- Familiar with Meta compliance risks involving health and beauty products.

- Available full time and interested in long-term work.



## NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplements, or personal-care products.

- Experience with UK, EU, Canada, Israel, Switzerland, or US markets.

- Experience writing advertorials, product pages, or offer pages.

- Experience leading designers or a small creative pod.

- A portfolio containing ads or angles that achieved measurable results.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word **ANGLE**.



Answer every question below. General or incomplete answers may not be considered.



1. How many years have you worked as a Creative Strategist for ecommerce or dropshipping brands?

2. Which products, niches, brands, and markets have you worked with?

3. Walk us through your complete swipe-research process.

4. What performance signals do you use to d
 whether a swipe is worth studying?

5. Share one winning angle you developed. Explain the research, insight, execution, and result.

6. How do you turn a competitor swipe into an original concept instead of copying it?

7. Have you written ad copy, advertorials, or landing pages? Please share examples.

8. How do you use campaign data when d
 what to iterate, stop, or replace?

9. What Meta compliance risks do you watch for in health and beauty advertising?

10. Have you led video edirtors? Describe your briefing and feedback process.

11. Share your CV, portfolio, sample briefs, swipe boards, landing pages, and any redacted performance evidence.

12. State your availability or earliest start date.

13. State your expected monthly salary in USD.



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a Creative Strategist assessment.

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
Senior IT Engineer



Prevent problems before they happen. Automate what shouldn’t be done twice. Do great work with great clients — and earn the autonomy to do it your way.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to close tickets faster. You’re here to make sure the same problem doesn’t come back — and ideally, to catch it before it ever reaches a ticket queue.



We’re looking for a Senior IT Engineer who thinks like an automator and operator first, a firefighter second. You’ll handle complex Tier 2/3 escalations when they arise, but your real work is building the systems, automations, and processes that prevent issues from happening in the first place. You’ll own client environments, lead from the front technically, and raise the standard of the team around you.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best engineers we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They hate doing the same thing twice. If they fix something manually, their next thought is: “How do I make sure no one — including me — has to do this again?”

They take ownership. From the 
nt a problem is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s fully resolved, documented, and won’t come back

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I fix this faster?” they ask “why is this happening, and how do I prevent it?”

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and resolutions are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to



Who Thrives Here



People who want to do genuinely good work, be trusted by their team, and build something that lasts. We move fast and hold a high bar — but we’ve also built an environment where people are respected, given real ownership, and invested in over time. Those things aren’t in conflict here.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is fully documented and not every system is perfect yet. For the right engineer, that’s not a problem — it’s the opportunity to shape how we operate, not just execute within it.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a fast-moving MSP environment where clients depend on you and junior engineers look to you. Your job isn’t just to solve the problem in front of you — it’s to make sure the team and the environment are better because you were there.



That looks like:



Serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and endpoint security — diagnosing root causes, not patching symptoms

Proactively auditing client environments to catch risks, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies before they become i

Building monitoring, alerting, and automation that catches problems early — or eliminates them entirely

Leading infrastructure projects end-to-end — cloud migrations, M365 deployments, network overhauls, security implementations — from scoping through delivery

Writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts that turn repetitive manual tasks into automated, reliable processes

Mentoring junior engineers so that when they come to you stuck, they leave sharper and more capable — not more dependent

Communicating clearly with clients and vendors — technical enough to be credible, human enough to build trust

Documenting everything you touch so clearly that others can build on it without asking you a single question



What We’re Looking For



5+ years of IT experience, minimum 2 in an MSP or multi-client environment — you’ve seen enough environments to know what good looks like

Deep proficiency in Windows Server (2016–2022), Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, and virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V) — you don’t need to look up the basics

Strong networking fundamentals — routing, switching, VLANs, firewall management (SonicWall, Fortinet, or Meraki); you can trace a problem through the stack

Solid Microsoft 365 and Azure experience (AZ-104 level or equivalent) — you know the platform well enough to administer, troubleshoot, and advise clients on it

PowerShell scripting proficiency — you write scripts that work, that others can read, and that solve real operational problems

Hands-on experience with RMM and PSA platforms (Datto, HaloPSA, NinjaRMM, or equivalent) — you know how to use your tools, not just log into them

VOIP support experience (3CX or similar) — you can configure, troubleshoot, and advise without escalating

Strong diagnostic skills — you find root causes, not just the closest available fix

Natural mentor — you make the engineers around you better without making them dependent on you

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to grow with a company, not job-hop



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand client environments, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their work, their tools, and their clients’ environments.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve taken full ownership of your client environments

Escalations from junior engineers are getting cleaner answers — and fewer of them

You know where the gaps are and you’ve already started closing them



At 6 months:



Recurring issues in your client environments are measurably down — because you automated them away, not just resolved them faster

Your documentation and scripts are becoming what the team reaches for first



At 12 months:



Clients notice the quality difference

The “this issue again?” 
nts have dropped significantly

Junior engineers are visibly sharper from working with you

You’ve shaped how we operate — and the business is investing in your next step



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need step-by-step direction to know what to do next

You fix the symptom and move on without asking why

You treat documentation as someone else’s responsibility

You’re comfortable letting a ticket sit without following through

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for a stable, low-pressure remote job with a predictable routine



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

This post is long and applying will take you 30 to 45 minutes. That is on purpose.



We already have one AI video editor and a Creative Strategist. We now have more ads to build than one editor can produce, so I am hiring ONE more editor. I would rather get 5 serious applications than 200 copy-paste ones.



You will not be inventing anything. You get a finished script, a visual brief, the product assets, reference ads, and every tool paid for by us. What you need is to already be good at this, to follow a brief to the letter, and to deliver on time.



THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT



You must already be able to do this work today. I am not hiring someone to learn AI video on my account and on my time.



And you must apply with a PORTFOLIO: links to finished videos or ads you made yourself. No portfolio, no reply. Tutorials, test renders, course projects and agency reels where I cannot tell which part was yours do not count.



ABOUT US



We run a cat supplement brand on Shopify, selling to Germany, Austria and Switzerland. We do six figures per month and scale with paid ads on
 and Instagram. Every ad we run is produced with AI - no film crew, no actors, no shipping products to creators.



Our bottleneck is the number of finished ads, not the budget. Ads burn out within a few weeks, and the more good ads we can put out, the bigger this brand gets. That is why this role exists.



HOW THE WORK REACHES YOU



- Our Creative Strategist writes every script and every brief. You never write copy and you never write German.

- Every job ("batch") gets its own Slack channel and a visual board: the script scene by scene, references, style and a deadline.

- You build the ad, check it against the brief, put the finished files into the job folder on Google Drive and post in the channel.

- The Creative Strategist reviews it. The goal is that it goes live without a single correction.



WHAT YOU WILL PRODUCE (all vertical 9:16)



- Animated storytelling ads - 3D Pixar-style characters (cats and their owners) telling a story across several scenes, with voiceover and captions

- AI UGC ads - a generated person on camera talking about the product, with their cat

- VSL and advertorial cuts - longer sales videos cut to a script, with captions

- 1:1 rebuilds of winning ads - same structure, same pacing, exactly one variable changed (a new hook or a new actor). "Close enough" is not a delivery.

- The finish: burned-in German captions inside the safe zone, hook in the first two seconds, levelled audio, no dead air, exported to spec



WHERE THIS JOB IS WON OR LOST



We have been doing this for a while now, and almost no correction is about skill. They are about reading the brief. These are the exact things that have cost us revision rounds so far:



1. A brief element is missed - a title card after the opening scene, one line that had to be emphasized, a specific pause. Before you build, go through the brief scene by scene and tick off every instruction. Before you deliver, do it again.

2. A word is split across two caption lines. Never. Captions break only between words.

3. Captions cover the product. The product always stays visible.

4. B-roll or stock-looking footage inside a storytelling ad. If the ad is a story, every shot belongs to the story. Use what the brief asks for.

5. German retyped instead of copied. Every German word is copied character for character from the script - capital letters, umlauts (ä ö ü ß) and numbers exactly as written. If the voiceover and the captions do not match, you ask. You do not guess.

6. Fixing one note and breaking another. A pause that was too short should not become too long. After every revision, watch the whole ad again, not only the part you changed.



If you read this list and think "that is obvious" - good. It is obvious. It still happens, and the person I hire is the one for whom it does not.



THE GERMAN PART - AND WHY IT IS NOT A PROBLEM



You do not need to speak a word of German. The Creative Strategist gives you the finished German script and approves the German on every ad. What I need is care with a language you do not speak: copy, never type, never "correct", and flag anything that looks off.



ACCOUNTABILITY AND COMMUNICATION



I do not need someone who never has a problem. People get sick, power goes out, typhoons happen, renders fail. Zero problem.



What ends this job is silence on a deadline. Deadlines are set in German time (Manila is six hours ahead). If you need longer, post it in the job channel BEFORE the deadline with a new time, and the deadline moves. That is all. Missing a deadline without a word is the one thing I cannot work with, because our ad launches are planned around your delivery.



Beyond that:



- You ask before you build when a brief is unclear - not after five wrong versions.

- You flag early if something in a script cannot be built the way it is written.

- You reply within your working day and you work independently, without being chased.

- You log your hours live in Clockify, and every entry says what you did and why.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING (hard requirements - no exceptions)



1. A PORTFOLIO - links to 2-3 finished videos or ads you made yourself. Own work only.

2. 2+ years of short-form video editing, and at least the last year of it with AI-generated footage.

3. AI video shipped in production - for clients, a brand or your own offers. Not tutorials, not test renders.

4. Hands-on with serious AI video generation (for example Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, Sora, Runway, Midjourney), and the judgment to redo a bad generation instead of shipping it.

5. Consistent characters - you can keep the same character looking the same across every scene of an ad.

6. CapCut or Premiere Pro for the cut, your pick.

7. Conversational English, written and spoken.

8. A computer that can actually handle video work, and reliable internet.

9. Willing to sign a freelance contract and an NDA before you get access to our assets.

10. Willing to do a short unpaid test (roughly one to two hours) before we get on a call.



BONUS (not required, but it moves you to the top of my list)



- 3D / Pixar-style character animation or claymation made with AI

- Paid ads experience, not just organic content

- Pet niche - cats especially

- After Effects

- You have edited in a language you do not speak



THE TOOLS - WE PAY FOR EVERYTHING



Every tool, every subscription and every generation credit is paid by us. You never spend your own money on this job. Our generation and voiceover stack is already set up, and you get access on day one. Tell me in your application which tools you are fastest in.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



1. Revision rounds per job - the target is zero. Your first delivery should be ready to go live.

2. Deadlines - hit, or moved in time

3. German text exactly as in the script

4. Communication - we always know where you are



WORKING HOURS



- 100% remote from anywhere in the Philippines, asynchronous. No shift, no fixed hours. You get a brief, you deliver by the agreed deadline, and how you organize your day is your business.

- Right now roughly 10 to 15 hours per week. Work is given per batch. As we scale, the hours grow.

- A short written update every Thursday, and one fixed 30-minute video call per week with me and the Creative Strategist, camera on.

- English is our working language. Slack for communication, Google Drive for files, Clockify for hours.



COMPENSATION (all amounts in USD)



$5 per hour, for the hours you actually work, tracked in Clockify. At 10 to 15 hours per week that is roughly $200 to $320 per month today, and it grows with volume.



- Paid every two weeks via Wise

- Every tool, subscription and generation credit paid by us

- Bonuses when the business does well

- Paid Philippine public holidays

- 13th month bonus after one full year

- Freelance contract and NDA

- 30-day trial, then long-term



If you work with other clients, that is completely fine with me, as long as my deadlines are met.



STOP. READ THIS PART CAREFULLY.



The very first word of your application must be TUNA.



Not in the middle. Not at the end. The first word, on its own line, before anything else. Like this:



TUNA



Hi Erik, ...



If your message does not start with TUNA, I will not read it - no matter how good your portfolio is. Following an instruction exactly is the job.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here through OnlineJobs.ph. Do not
 me. Start your message with TUNA on its own line, then answer all 6 questions. Be specific - vague answers are the fastest way to get rejected.



1. YOUR PORTFOLIO. Links to 2-3 videos or ads YOU made. For each one: which tools you used, which parts were AI-generated, and what exactly your part was. If you have an animated or character-based piece, include it.



2. YOUR AI WORK. Pick one video you linked and walk me through how you made it - what you generated, what failed and what you had to redo. How do you keep a character looking the same across scenes?



3. YOUR CHECK BEFORE YOU DELIVER. You have just finished an ad from a detailed brief. Describe step by step what you check before you send it. Be concrete.



4. FOREIGN LANGUAGE. How do you make sure captions in a language you do not speak end up 100% correct on screen - no missing letters, no split words, no mismatch with the voiceover? Have you done this before? In which language?



5. YOUR SPEED AND YOUR SITUATION. How many finished 15-second vertical ads can you build in one working day, starting from a script? A real number, not "many". Which editing program and which computer do you use? When can you start, and how many hours per week can you commit? Are you okay with $5 per hour tracked in Clockify, and with a short unpaid test before we get on a call?



6. A 60-SECOND RECORDING OF YOURSELF SPEAKING ENGLISH. Loom, a voice message or an unlisted YouTube link. Introduce yourself and walk me through one of the videos you linked. No script, no editing - phone camera or just audio is completely fine. I want to hear how you speak English.



Applications that do not start with TUNA, skip any of the 6 questions or have no portfolio links will not be reviewed.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. I read your application and watch your portfolio.

2. Short unpaid test: one 15-second ad in German from our script and assets, roughly one to two hours of work, 48 hours to deliver.

3. Video call in English, camera on.

4. A paid trial job on a real brief, then we start the 30-day trial.



I read every application that follows the instructions, and I reply fast. If this sounds like you, apply today.



Start your message with: TUNA

title: Creator & Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
Remote | Full-Time | DTC / E-commerce



About Moon Nude



Moon Nude is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand creating thoughtfully designed quilted bags and accessories for women worldwide. We sell through our online store, Amazon, and TikTok Shop.



We’re a small, founder-led, fully remote team looking for a hands-on, performance-driven Creator & Influencer Marketing Manager to own our creator and influencer program from end to end.



This is not purely a relationship-management role. You’ll source creators, manage partnerships, oversee content production, run our creator community, and analyze performance to determine what we should improve, repeat, and scale.



Key Responsibilities

Source, assess, negotiate with, and manage creators and influencers.

Manage paid partnerships, product gifting, seeding, affiliate relationships, and ambassador programs.

Build a reliable pipeline of creators producing high-quality, on-brand content.

Negotiate rates, deliverables, timelines, usage rights, and partnership terms.

Create clear and actionable creator briefs.

Review creator content and provide detailed feedback on hooks, messaging, storytelling, product presentation, and conversion potential.

Manage Trybe, our owned creator community, including recruitment, onboarding, communications, feedback sessions, and creator engagement.

Recruit and manage TikTok Shop creators and affiliates.

Coordinate samples, commissions, content deadlines, contracts, approvals, payments, and follow-ups.

Identify and manage brand partnerships, giveaways, collaborations, and joint campaigns.

Maintain organized trackers for creators, content, costs, deliverables, and performance.

Analyze metrics including views, engagement, clicks, conversions, sales, CPA, ROI, and content efficiency.

Identify top-performing creators, hooks, concepts, formats, and messages.

Translate performance insights into better briefs and creator feedback.

Provide regular reports, insights, and recommendations to the founders.

Coordinate creator output with launches, paid advertising, and wider business priorities.

What We’re Looking For

Previous experience managing creator, influencer, affiliate, or ambassador programs.

Hands-on experience managing campaigns from creator sourcing through execution, reporting, and optimization.

Strong understanding of social media trends, influencer culture, and creator-led content that converts.

Confidence negotiating rates, usage rights, deliverables, and timelines.

Strong analytical skills and experience using performance data to make decisions.

Excellent organization and project-management skills.

Strong written and spoken English.

Personable, proactive, persistent, and comfortable holding creators accountable.

Willingness to review content closely, update trackers, follow up on late deliverables, and solve operational issues.

Ability to work independently in a fast-moving, founder-led environment.

Nice to Have

Experience in fashion, accessories, beauty, lifestyle, or another visually driven DTC or e-commerce category.

Experience managing TikTok Shop creators or affiliates.

Familiarity with creator content used in Meta or other paid social advertising.

Experience building or managing an owned creator community.

Existing relationships within the creator and influencer space.

How to Apply



Please submit your CV or résumé along with examples of creator or influencer work you have personally managed or helped deliver.



Your examples do not need to be presented as a polished case study. Please briefly include:



The creator programs or types of creators you managed

Your specific responsibilities

Campaigns or content you helped produce

Relevant performance results or lessons

Examples of briefs, reports, creator content, trackers, or program systems you developed, if available



Please also answer the following in your application:



How many years of creator or influencer marketing experience do you have?

Have you managed TikTok Shop creators or affiliates?

What performance metrics do you normally track?

What tools have you used to manage creator campaigns?

What is your expected monthly salary?

When are you available to start?



We’re looking for evidence of genuine, hands-on experience and strong strategic thinking—not a perfectly packaged portfolio.



Please start your application with the word MOONBEAM so we know you've read the entire job description.

title: eCommerce Video Editor Application - Moon Nude
description:

You turn raw footage and UGC into high-performing short-form video ads that sell. Working from a creative strategist's briefs inside a creative pod, you'll produce a high volume of paid-social video — primarily for Meta, plus TikTok and other channels — and iterate fast on what's winning. captions/subtitles, sound design, and light motion.

• Move fast: turn briefs around quickly and fold in feedback from strategists and performance data.

• Tools: fluent in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro, plus After Effects for light motion.

title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be confident in learning platforms, checking integrations, and spotting data inconsistencies.



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have strong English communication skills, especially in written updates and documentation.

• Are detail-oriented and can spot inconsistencies in data, reports, workflows, and CRM records.

• Are tech-savvy and comfortable learning tools like HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow.

• Have experience with CRM management, reporting, lead tracking, or sales operations support.

• Can follow instructions carefully while also thinking ahead and identifying potential issues.

• Are proactive, resourceful, and willing to explore possible solutions before escalating.

• Can communicate blockers clearly and ask thoughtful questions when context is missing.

• Are comfortable working in a backend support role with limited customer-facing responsibilities.

• Can maintain confidentiality when handling client, customer, sales, and revenue-related data.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



• HubSpot CRM, pipelines, properties, workflows, reports, or dashboards

• CallRail tracking numbers, call source attribution, or lead source cleanup

• RingCentral or other VoIP/call center platforms

• Webflow content updates or website maintenance

• Sales operations, marketing operations, or CRM administration

• Process documentation, SOP creation, or backend operations support

• Google Sheets, Excel, or reporting/data cleanup tasks



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements: To ensure a smooth and efficient remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen or AMD Ryzen 5 (or higher)

• Minimum 8GB RAM

• Device (laptop or PC) must be less than 3 years old

• Stable internet: 50–100 Mbps, with a backup connection

• Quality webcam, mic, and headset

Screenshots of your device specs and an internet speed test will be required upon application.



Why You’ll Love Working with Claud?

• Paid holidays & PTO

• HMO (after 1st year)

• Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG & referral incentives

• Weekends off

• Free learning sessions & fun company events

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community



Let's Get to Know You: Please include your answers to the following in your application :

1. In one paragraph, tell us about yourself.

2. What are your key strengths that would help you excel in this role?

3. What challenges do you foresee in this role?



Don’t just look for a job - build a meaningful career filled with freedom, balance, and the support you deserve.



Apply today!

Make outbound calls from our provided list.



Ask to have Remove It Pros added to the company's demolition bid list.



Ask whether they have any current or upcoming demolition projects that we can bid.



Get the best
 address for sending our company information and bid requests.



Verify the company's current business address.



Record the results of every call accurately in our CRM.



Keep moving through the list and maintain a high daily call volume.

"Hi, this is John with Remove It Pros. We're a demolition contractor here in Southwest Florida, and I was calling to see if we could get added to your bid list for upcoming demolition projects."

Then:



"Could I get the best

Finally:



"And can I verify your current company address?"

This Is an Ongoing Position



This isn't a short project.



We have approximately 19,000 businesses in our database. We want to work through the entire database and then start over and continue building relationships with these companies.



The goal is simple:



Get Remove It Pros more opportunities to bid demolition projects.

Your cold-calling experience.



Your experience calling U.S. businesses.



How many outbound calls you can realistically make during an 8-hour day.
