title: Experienced E-Commerce Customer Support Representative ($1M+/Month DTC Brands Only)
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce company running a portfolio of DTC brands, selling to customers in the US, UK, Canada and Australia. We're looking for experienced Customer Support Representatives who have already worked inside e-commerce brands doing at least $1M per month in revenue.



This is not an entry-level role. If you've never handled a high-volume Shopify inbox, please don't apply. If you have, and you're tired of working for brands with no process, read on.



WHY THE $1M/MONTH REQUIREMENT



At that size, support is a different job. Hundreds of tickets a day, subscription cancellations, chargeback threats, shipping delays hitting thousands of orders at once, macros, SLAs, escalation paths. We want people who have lived that and know how to stay fast and accurate under volume.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Work our ticket queue by
 and chat: order status, shipping delays, lost packages, refunds, returns, product questions, complaints

- Handle subscription requests (pause, skip, swap, cancel) and run our retention flow on cancellations

- De-escalate angry customers and prevent chargebacks before they happen

- Look up the order, tracking and subscription status before you reply, so the customer's problem is solved in ONE message, not three

- Review and correct AI-drafted replies before they are sent

- Flag patterns to the team (a carrier issue, a product question that keeps coming back, a broken page on the site)



HOW WE MEASURE YOU



1. Response time: every ticket answered within 4 hours, 7 days a week

2. One-touch resolution: the fewer messages it takes to fully solve a ticket, the better

3. Quality: correct policy, correct product info, warm and human tone



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years in e-commerce / DTC customer support

- Direct experience at one or more brands doing $1M+ per month (you'll be asked to name them)

- Excellent written English: natural, warm and clear, never robotic or scripted

- Shopify admin experience (orders, refunds, cancellations)

- Helpdesk experience: Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Freshdesk, Richpanel or similar

- Subscription app experience: Loop, Recharge, Skio or similar

- Comfortable handling refunds, chargeback threats and retention conversations

- Self-sufficient: you read the SOP once and run with it

- Stable internet, a backup connection and a quiet workspace

- Able to work hours overlapping with US time zones, including some weekend coverage on a rotation



NICE TO HAVE



- Health, wellness, supplements or beauty niche experience

- Experience training or QA-ing other agents

- Experience working alongside AI tools in support



WHAT YOU GET



- Long-term, full-time role with a growing brand portfolio

- A written SOP and handbook with clear policies, so you're never guessing

- An in-house support system where orders, subscriptions and customer history are on one screen

- Pay based on proven experience, with raises tied to performance

- Room to grow into a senior / team lead role as the team scales



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words "Million dollar inbox" so we know you read the whole post. Then answer:



1. Which brands have you supported that did $1M+ per month? Include the store URL, your role, and how long you worked there.

2. How many tickets did you personally handle per day, and which helpdesk and subscription tools did you use?

3. Write the reply you would send to this customer: "I cancelled my subscription last week and you charged me AGAIN. I want my money back today or I'm disputing it with my bank."

4. Your time zone and the hours you are available each day.



Applications without the answers above will not be reviewed.

title: Process Specialist
description:
Position Overview:



The Process Specialist is responsible for creating, documenting, maintaining, and continuously improving Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across departments. This role works closely with the Operations Manager and collaborates with Admin Operations, Resource Management, Finance, and Field teams to translate workflows, from simple to complex, into clear, scalable, and user-friendly documentation. The ideal candidate has strong process-thinking skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and experience using documentation and training platforms such as Trainual. Construction or trade-industry experience is a strong plus.



Pay Range: $7 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.



About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.



Objectives:

-Create, document, and maintain clear, accurate, and scalable SOPs for simple, intermediate, and advanced operational processes.

-Ensure SOPs remain current by proactively updating documentation based on process changes, system updates, and leadership direction.

-Coordinate with department leaders and subject matter experts to capture workflows accurately and translate them into user-friendly documentation.

-Write, organize, publish and manage SOPs within Trainual and other documentation or training platforms to ensure accessibility and consistency.

-Support company-wide process standardization to improve efficiency, accountability, and cross-team alignment.

-Assist with process rollouts by supporting training materials, announcements, and change documentation as needed.

-Identify gaps, redundancies, or inefficiencies in existing processes and recommend improvements.



Competencies:

-Strong process-thinking and analytical skills with the ability to break down complex workflows into clear, actionable steps and visual process flowcharts.

-Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a high level of clarity, structure, and attention to detail.

-Proven ability to write and update SOPs for both technical and non-technical audiences.

-Experience using Trainual or similar documentation, knowledge management, or LMS platforms.

-Ability to manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

-Strong collaboration skills to work cross-functionally with leadership, operations, and field teams.

-Comfort asking probing questions to fully understand processes and identify edge cases.

-Change-management mindset with the ability to document evolving processes without disruption.

-Training or onboarding experience is a plus, particularly in explaining processes to new team members.

-Construction, electrical, or trade-industry experience is a strong plus.



Education and Experience:

-At least 2 years of experience in process documentation, SOP creation, operations support, or a related role.

-Experience writing SOPs for operational, administrative, or technical processes.

-Experience with Trainual or similar documentation/training platforms is highly preferred.

-Construction, electrical, facilities, or field-operations experience is a plus.

-Experience supporting training, onboarding, or internal enablement initiatives is a plus.



Equipment Requirements:

-Computer or laptop capable of handling documentation platforms, process mapping, and collaboration tools.

-Stable and reliable internet connection for online operations and virtual communication.



Physical Requirements:

-Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

-Competitive salary is commensurate with experience.

-Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

-Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

-Opportunity for advancement within the company.

-A supportive and collaborative work environment.

-Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

-Paid vacation.



How to Apply:

If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its team members and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/careers/process-specialist



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: Content Creator & Influencer Outreach
description:
Do you want more from life?



MailWorkers is growing rapidly internationally. We’re now looking for people who see a position as the beginning of something more, something that brings you closer to your dreams and goals.



If you know how to capture attention and turn it into growth, you like to see the impact of your work firsthand, and want to discover what you’re capable of achieving, this may be the opportunity you’ve been looking for.



Work remotely from anywhere. Choose your schedule. Meet new people from around the world. Take on real responsibility and see what happens when your own performance starts creating opportunities.



The Job?



You’ll help us grow internationally through content, creators, influencers and new collaborations.



You might be someone who knows how to find interesting content creators and influencers, reach out to them and turn conversations into collaborations.



Or you might be the creator yourself.



Someone who knows how to make quality videos, write interesting content, develop ideas and create material that actually gets people's attention.



Ideally, you have experience or a strong interest in areas such as fashion, art, lifestyle, content creation or marketing, and understand what makes content look and feel genuinely good.



You’ll have clear goals, proper guidance when needed, and the freedom to find your own way of getting results.



Prove yourself, take on more responsibility, and you can advance into bigger roles as we grow together.



No experience in this exact position? That’s okay, as long as you already have something to bring to it.



Maybe you’ve created videos, written content, grown a social media account, worked with influencers, done outreach, studied fashion or art, or simply have a very good eye for what catches people's attention.



We’ll give you what you need, training, structure and proper guidance, then let you discover what you can do with it.



That does not mean this is for everyone. We want real ambition and drive.



Those who know how to get things done, think creatively and know how to read between the lines.



Who Qualifies?!



We’re looking for those who aren’t afraid to try new positions. If you’re searching for bigger challenges in life, open to trying something you haven’t tried before, and curious to see how far you can go, maybe you should apply.



You’ll be given responsibility. You’ll be challenged. And if you show that you can handle it, you’ll be given more.



We’re looking for women who understand people, can read between the lines and are comfortable being themselves.



Bring your personality. Bring your confidence. Show us what makes you different.



Where could it lead?



Strong performers may be offered longer-term opportunities, greater responsibility and higher compensation.



For the right person, there may eventually be an opportunity to relocate to the Netherlands and work with us in Amsterdam.



It isn’t promised.



It’s something you earn.



There may be an opportunity much bigger than you imagined sitting right in front of you. You just have to reach for it.



If you think you have what it takes, send your CV, a few recent pictures and a short personal introduction.



Send it directly to Founder & Owner : 



MailWorkers.eu



Because people trust people.

title: AI Operations & Customer Support Specialist (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We run an online service business that helps people recover and manage Instagram accounts. Our customers order through an app, and a lot of our operation runs on AI assistants that talk to customers, answer questions and move orders along.



The AI does a lot - but it cannot be left alone. That is the job.



WHAT YOU WOULD BE DOING



1) WATCHING OVER OUR AI ASSISTANTS (about half your time)



We have several AI assistants that message customers directly - one handles sales conversations, one handles order updates, one handles support tickets, and others. All of them are in your scope. Your job is to be the human checking their work:



- Read what the AI said to customers and spot anything wrong: a made-up answer, a promise we cannot keep, the wrong price, a rude or robotic reply, or the same message sent over and over

- Flag it, pause that assistant yourself if it is doing damage (you will have the controls - we would rather you stop it at 10pm than wait for us), and tell us what happened

- Notice patterns, not just one-off mistakes ("it keeps doing X with this type of customer")

- Step in and reply as a human when the AI is out of its depth



You do not need to be technical and you will not be programming. You need to be the person who reads something that sounds confident and thinks "hang on, that's not right."



2) CUSTOMER SUPPORT TICKETS (about a third of your time)



- Answer customer questions and complaints in our support system

- Chase customers for information we need to finish their order

- Keep tickets moving so nothing sits ignored for days



3) SERVICE DELIVERY (the rest)



- Complete customer orders by hand on our phones, following a written step-by-step guide

- It is roughly 10-15 minutes per order once you know it

- Tell the customer when it is done, or ask for what is missing



BEING HONEST ABOUT THE WORK



- A lot of it is repetitive. Reading AI conversations and completing the same order checklist. Some people find that steady and satisfying; others are bored in a month and quit. Please know yourself.

- It is screen-heavy and detail-heavy. Accuracy matters far more than speed.

- The hours are long and it is 6 days a week. Please only apply if that genuinely suits you.

- You will find mistakes, including ours. We want someone who says "this is wrong" rather than someone who goes along with it.

- What it is not: no cold calling, no sales targets, no content creation, no coding.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Good written English. You message customers directly. It does not need to be perfect, but it must be clear, warm and typo-light.

- Judgement. The core skill is spotting when something is wrong even though it sounds convincing.

- Careful and consistent. One wrong tap can cost a customer their appeal.

- Comfortable with phones, two-factor authentication and backup codes. Not technical - just not nervous about it.

- A reliable setup. Stable internet and power for your whole shift, and a quiet place to work.

- Completely trustworthy. You will have access to customer account details. This is monitored and logged, you will sign a confidentiality agreement, and you will start on a paid trial.



Nice to have (not required): customer support, content moderation, social media management, quality assurance, or any experience working alongside AI tools.



THE DETAILS



- Pay: $4 per hour, paid hourly (about $1,040/month at 60 hours a week). Paid on time, every time.

- Hours: about 10 hours a day, 6 days a week (roughly 60 hours a week). Our customers are in Europe, so the working window is roughly 2:00pm - 11:00pm Philippine time.

- Trial: 1-2 week PAID trial on real work before we commit long-term.

- Long-term and stable. We want someone for years, not weeks.

- Real authority: you can pause an AI assistant yourself when it is doing damage. We trust the person doing the watching to act, not to file a report and wait.

- Everything is browser-based on our systems. You need a reliable computer and a stable internet connection, nothing else.

- Your rate is reviewed after the first 3 months.



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Please do not send a generic CV or a cover letter written by AI. We can tell, and it is an instant no - partly because this job is about spotting AI output.



Answer all 9 points below, in this order. Applications that skip any point will not be read.



1. Start your message with the words "human check" so we know you read this properly.



2. YOUR LAST RELEVANT JOB: where, how long, and what you actually did day to day. Please include how many customers or tickets you handled per day, and which tools you used (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Gorgias,
,
, or none). If you have no support experience, say so plainly - willingness to learn is fine, but be honest.



3. TELL US ABOUT A REAL TIME YOU CAUGHT SOMEONE ELSE'S MISTAKE AT WORK - what it was, how you noticed, and what you did about it. One short paragraph. This is the closest thing to the actual job, so please give a real example, not a general statement.



4. READ THIS MESSAGE that an AI assistant sent to a real customer, and tell us what is wrong with it:



"Hi! Good news, we're sending the login request to your phone again right now and our team is actively working on your account as we speak. You should see it come through in the next few minutes. We'll have this fully resolved for you today, guaranteed!"



The truth at that moment: nothing was running, nobody was working on the account, and we had no idea when it would be resolved.



In your own words: what is wrong here, and why does it matter? (3-4 sentences)



5. A customer messages: "this is taking forever, I want a refund." Our policy is that we do not give refunds - we fix the problem or replace the account. Write the exact message you would send back to this customer.



6. You notice our AI has sent the same customer almost the same message 8 times in one night. What do you do, and in what order? (2-3 sentences)



7. Confirm you can work about 10 hours a day, 6 days a week, in the 2:00pm - 11:00pm Philippine time window. Also tell us your expected hourly rate in USD.



8. YOUR WORK SETUP - please be specific, because we need you online for the whole shift:

   - Your internet provider and your actual speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal)

   - Your backup if the internet goes down (mobile data, pocket wifi, a second provider?)

   - How often your area has brownouts, and what you do if the power goes out mid-shift (UPS, power bank, generator, a cafe nearby?)

   - Your computer (make and rough age), and whether you have a quiet place to work



Please be honest here. We would much rather know about a weekly brownout up front than discover it in week two. Having a backup plan matters more to us than having perfect conditions.



9. Your CV or OnlineJobs profile, plus one sentence on which part of it is most relevant to this specific job.



Everyone who follows all 9 steps gets a reply. Shortlisted candidates get a short paid test task before any interview.

 the company directly. Any candidate who contacts the company outside of the OnlineJobs system will be disqualified from consideration.



Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant



$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.



This is not a general administrative assistant role. This role is best suited for someone with experience coordinating schedules, customers, and day-to-day operations in a fast-paced service environment.

-Customer phone support experience

-Dispatch or logistics experience

-Google Workspace

Work Requirements

-Full-time availability

-Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time

-Fluent spoken and written English

-Reliable computer and dedicated workspace

-Reliable internet connection with a backup option

-Backup power solution

$6–$8 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience.



Candidates with direct Jobber experience, mobile-team scheduling experience, and strong customer phone skills will receive priority consideration.

-Connection

-Quality

-Service

-Teamwork

APPLY, we'd love to work with you, part or full time.

title: Customer Service & Store Operations Assistant - True Gear
description:
True Gear is a small Australian ecommerce business selling adventure gear. Have a look at what we sell at 
. It's a genuinely small operation, just the owner and one part-time sales rep, no layers of management and no corporate red tape.



The role



We're after someone based in the Philippines to be the main point of contact for our customers, and to help keep the operational and admin side of the store running. This isn't a script-reading support job, but you also don't need deep product knowledge to start. Anyone who's ready to buy or wants sales advice gets forwarded straight to our sales rep, that side stays separate. We'll grow your product knowledge over time as it becomes useful, and we may end up keeping sales and support fully separate long-term rather than expecting one person to do both.



It's a genuinely small team: you, the owner, and one part-time sales rep. Most days you'll be working directly alongside the owner, not buried under layers of management.



Customer service is the core of the role and where most of your week goes. Alongside it, there's some simple admin: tracking numbers and shipments, keeping the inbox organised, basic bookkeeping and invoicing, and other small ongoing tasks as they come up. Nothing here needs a specialist skillset, it's work that needs doing between customer conversations.



What you'll actually be doing

Answering customer enquiries by
, SMS and phone, first point of contact for everything post-purchase and for quick pre-purchase questions

Forwarding anyone ready to buy, or after sales advice, straight to our sales rep, closing the sale isn't your job

Managing tracking numbers and shipments: chasing couriers, keeping customers updated, sorting out delivery issues

Investigating whatever a customer needs looked into (order status, stock, a supplier query) and getting the answer back to them yourself

Handling the store's day-to-day inbox, keeping it organised and on top of things

Basic bookkeeping and invoicing

General admin as it comes up

What we're looking for



Three things matter most, everything else is a bonus:



Takes feedback well. Because it's such a small team, you'll get honest, direct feedback fairly often, especially while you're learning the ropes in the first few weeks. We genuinely care how you're doing, it's not about catching you out, it's about helping you get better quickly. We're after someone who can take that feedback on board and keep moving forward with it.

Strong work ethic. Able to work independently once you know the systems, without needing to be watched or chased. You'll be trained on our tools (Trello, Slack, Gmail, Shopify), but this isn't a role for someone who needs constant supervision.

Great communication. Clear, well-spoken English is a big plus, you'll be talking to Australian customers directly. Natural over scripted. Calm and honest, if you don't know something, it's fine to say so and follow up.



Nice to have, not required:



Comfortable in Shopify, or a fast learner who's used similar platforms

Knowledge about electricity and power

Experience with freight or courier coordination



You don't need to arrive already knowing the products. That's something you'll pick up on the job, not a day-one requirement.



Why work with us

It's a small business, not a corporation. There are guidelines and structure, but we're reasonable and friendly, and can accommodate things when they come up.

This isn't a high-pressure or overly stressful role.

You'll have an integrated Claude AI agent set up to help you work through tasks efficiently, and a Claude Pro subscription is included as part of the role.

One paid day off per month, and unpaid leave can be accommodated when you need it.

Hours and pay

9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday, Melbourne time (transitions between AEST and AEDT through the year), with a one-hour lunch break

AUD $1,020 per month, paid fortnightly

Commission structure available after the trial period: up to an extra $300 per month in bonuses, with standard commission around $100 per month tied to business and/or personal performancc

Independent contractor role

Hours are logged with time-tracking software for the whole shift, standard for this kind of role



If you've read this far, start your application message with the word "Tracked". We get a lot of applications for roles like this, and it's the fastest way to tell us you've read the whole posting rather than just the title.



Trial period and ongoing terms



Three month trial period, either party can end the arrangement without cause during this time. After that, the agreement rolls monthly with one month's written notice either way. Contractor is responsible for their own tax and insurance, standard for an independent contractor arrangement.



How to apply



Send your application with a short cover message, and complete this short screening form as part of your application (about 15-20 minutes):

title: Creative Designer
description:
Creative Designer

US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time

Great design is still a human skill. The best creatives today just have better tools — and know exactly when to use them.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company

We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role

We're looking for a Creative Designer who understands that AI doesn't make great design — designers do. But the right tools, used well, make great designers faster, more prolific, and more creative than they'd be without them.

You'll own full creative production across marketing, brand, and content — static, motion, and video. You'll use AI where it genuinely helps: ideation, exploration, iteration, and production acceleration. And you'll apply your own judgment, taste, and craft to make sure the final output is something a machine could never produce on its own.



The Mindset We're Looking For

The best creative professionals we've worked with share a few traits:



They know that AI makes a great starting point, not a finished product. They use it to explore ideas faster, break through creative blocks, and accelerate production — then they take it the rest of the way themselves

They have strong creative instincts that no tool can replicate. They know when something is off, when something isn't good enough, and what it would take to make it right

They take ownership of quality. They don't ship work they're not proud of — regardless of how it was made

They're curious about new tools and genuinely open to learning them — not because someone told them to, but because staying sharp matters to them

They communicate clearly about creative decisions. They can explain why something works, take feedback without getting defensive, and push back when a direction isn't right





Who Thrives Here

People who are serious about the craft and smart about the tools. You believe a human designer will always make the work better — and you prove it in everything you ship. You're not resistant to AI, but you're not dependent on it either. You know the difference.

We're a growing MSP with expanding creative needs across marketing, brand, and content. For the right person, that's the opportunity to shape a creative function that produces exceptional work — not just efficient work.



What You'll Do

You'll walk into a business with real creative output needs across marketing, brand, and content — and the expectation that everything that ships is something you're proud to put your name on.

That looks like:



Producing the full range of marketing and brand creative — social graphics, digital ads, email campaigns, presentations, and promotional materials — at a high standard, on time, every time

Using AI tools for ideation, concept exploration, and production support — then applying your own judgment and craft to take the output where it needs to go

Creating motion graphics, short-form video, and reels that drive real engagement — not just content that fills a calendar

Generating and refining AI imagery and integrating it into polished, on-brand work where it makes the piece stronger, not just faster

Maintaining brand consistency across every output — and flagging when guidelines need to evolve, not just following them blindly

Building reusable templates, asset libraries, and brand components that make the creative process more consistent and scalable

Collaborating with marketing and leadership to translate campaign objectives into creative that performs — not just looks good

Staying current on both design craft and emerging tools — bringing the best of both into the work





What We're Looking For



A strong portfolio demonstrating range across static, motion, and video creative — this is the first and most important filter

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro or equivalent) — your craft fundamentals are solid and don't depend on AI to cover gaps

Openness to and working familiarity with AI creative tools (image generation, AI video, AI-assisted workflows) — you've explored them, you use them selectively, and you understand their limits

Motion graphics and video production capability — concept, produce, and deliver independently

Strong understanding of marketing principles and branding — every design decision serves a purpose

Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to; creative conversations and feedback feel easy, not formal

High attention to detail — you catch what's off before anyone else does

Self-directed — brief in, questions asked upfront, work delivered without hand-holding

Honest communicator — if a direction isn't working, you say so and come with a better idea



Nice to have:



Experience with AI video tools (Runway, Kling, Pika, or equivalent) used as part of a broader creative process

UI/UX or web design experience

Photography or videography skills

Experience in a marketing team or agency environment





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)

We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our brand, our clients, our standards, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership and quality work earn autonomy quickly — and significant creative latitude to shape how the brand looks, feels, and moves.

We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like

At three months: You're producing on-brand creative consistently and on time across static and motion formats. The work is clearly yours — AI may have helped, but the quality is unmistakably human. You've identified gaps in the creative library and started filling them.

At six months: Marketing campaigns have stronger visual execution than before you joined. Motion and video content is a regular part of output. You've introduced tools or workflows that made the team faster without lowering the creative bar.

At twelve months: The brand looks and feels measurably more polished. You've built systems and asset libraries that scale beyond your own output.



How We Work

We trust our people to do great work and give them the space to do it. Meaningful work means making decisions — and sometimes those won't be right on the first try. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn and move forward.

We're a growing MSP — not every creative process is built yet. That's part of why we need someone who brings craft and structure to the work, not just waits for direction.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You rely on AI to do all the creative thinking for you

You ship work that's technically complete but not something you're proud of

You treat brand guidelines as optional

Feedback makes you defensive rather than curious

You're not interested in learning new tools or evolving how you work

You separate craft from process — great output requires both



There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: Business Automation Analyst
description:
Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary.



We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?”

They take ownership. From the moment a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them.

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?”

They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for.

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to.



Who Thrives Here



People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better.



You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them.



That looks like:



Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them

Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself

Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand

Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust

Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question

Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around

Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better



What We’re Looking For



Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on

Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort

Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it

Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation platforms — you’ve actually built things with them, not just read about them

Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of an operational problem, not just the most obvious fix

Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to build something, not just fill a role



Nice to Have



API integration experience

Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new team members.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how the business operates, our tools, our standards, and where the biggest opportunities are. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their systems, their tools, and how the business runs.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve mapped the highest-impact manual processes in the business and have at least two automation solutions live and running

Your documentation is already being used by others



At 6 months:



Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves

Teams are spending less time on manual data work and more time on decisions

You’ve identified the next wave of improvements without being asked



At 12 months:



The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined

You’ve built systems that others rely on — and you’re already improving them again



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — the business depends on it — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a detailed task list to know what to work on

You build something once and consider it done

You document only when asked

You’re more comfortable maintaining existing systems than questioning why they exist

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for predictable, low-ambiguity work with clear daily instructions



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment
